units.name: B00_SkipOccludedLevelCaller

regions.summary: 159 bounded actor frame records, including four unreferenced records matching the consumer format. Each has an eleven-byte header, then four-byte sprite components (X, Y, attributes, tile) and a single FF component terminator. Header offsets 2/3 are origin X/Y, 4 participates in motion, 8 selects CHR, 9/10 give collision half-width/height, and 11 begins components. Renderer forward/mirrored paths and fixed rectangle builders share these records. The 155 referenced records plus four exact gap records cover this whole domain; unreferenced does not mean unused.

units.name: B12_RenderActorsAlternating
units.summary: Initialize CHR selectors and alternate ascending/descending actor order.

units.name: B12_SelectActorCHR
units.summary: A rendered actor of type $0D can select a CHR byte from frame-record offset 8. Other actor types leave the selector unchanged.

units.name: B12_RenderPlayerWithBlink
units.summary: Save OAM cursors, skip hidden player state, render slot zero and choose player CHR. During the blink interval, restore cursors on selected phases to discard emitted sprites.

units.name: B12_RenderActorSlot
units.summary: Skip inactive slots or null frame pointers. Resolve the actor's flags and frame pointer, choose CHR selector when applicable, update movement and select one of four flip combinations from actor/frame flags.

units.name: B12_ApplyFrameMotion
units.summary: When gameplay is active, apply signed frame offsets to 16-bit actor coordinates. Direction changes addition/subtraction; player motion also invokes the horizontal environmental displacement helper.

units.name: B12_ApplyOppositeFrameMotion
units.summary: Opposite facing adds X offset and subtracts Y offset instead of the other direction.

units.name: B12_RenderUnflippedFrame
units.summary: Subtract frame origin offsets from camera-relative coordinates. Four-byte sprite entries start at record offset $0B and terminate at $FF. Reject nonzero high-byte positions, Y >=$A6 and OAM count >=64 before emitting.

units.name: B12_NextUnflippedSprite
units.summary: Clip each component before writing one OAM entry; advance by four record bytes.

units.name: B12_ActorFrameReturn
units.summary: Frame terminator, clipping capacity or completion returns here.

units.name: B12_RenderVerticalFlip
units.summary: Project actor coordinates, apply the frame origins and draw the forward-X component path with vertical component subtraction and visibility clipping.

units.name: B15_FindRemainingTypeSixActor
units.summary: Search actor indices 31 down to one for type six without the retired flag. Carry set returns the actor in Y; clear means none remain.

units.name: B15_FindTypeSixBelowPlayerOffset
units.summary: Add unsigned A to player Y and search remaining type-six actors at or above that threshold. Carry set returns the selected actor; clear rejects.

units.name: B15_BringSelectedActorIntoView
units.summary: Remember selected actor Y, test horizontal/vertical visibility, and move the player/camera toward it. Choose a vertical approach when the actor is outside the required window.

units.name: B15_IsSelectedActorVerticallyVisible
units.summary: Subtract camera Y from selected actor Y. Carry set reports a zero high byte and low Y below 90; clear rejects.

units.name: B15_IsSelectedActorHorizontallyCentered
units.summary: Subtract camera X from selected actor X. Carry set reports X in 40 through BF on the current page.

units.name: B15_ApproachActorFromAbove
units.summary: If needed center the player and request a camera-axis change, then step Y downward by three over a bounded span, pacing each step by the frame timer and gameplay update helper.

units.name: B15_ApproachActorFromBelow
units.summary: After camera motion stops, step player Y upward by three over a bounded span and tick presentation between steps. Clear the alternate-approach latch on completion.

units.name: B15_AdvancePastActorWindow
units.summary: Center/change camera axis if needed, then move player down by three over a latch-dependent 144- or 240-pixel span, updating gameplay between steps.

units.name: B15_TickContinuationPresentation
units.summary: Prepare pending actor work and invoke the bank-13 gameplay update. Called after frame waits in the scripted continuation movement loops.

units.name: B15_CenterPlayerInWorldPage
units.summary: Move player X by three per frame toward the central 178..181 window in the selected world page. Wait for camera motion and tick presentation throughout; direction depends on the initial page and coordinate.

units.name: B15_AlignPlayerXToSelectedActor
units.summary: Compute the signed 16-bit X difference to the selected actor and step by three toward it. Stop when the difference crosses zero or the actor enters the centered screen window; rescan active type-six targets between steps.

units.name: B15_RefreshSelectedTypeSixActor
units.summary: Search active slots for type-six actors. If the selected target changes, remove the immediate return address and restart the X-alignment routine with the replacement index.

units.name: B15_AlignPlayerYToSelectedActor
units.summary: After camera motion settles, compute the signed 16-bit Y difference and step by three toward the selected actor, ticking frame/presentation work between steps. Stop on crossing the target. Static parameterized contract; natural entry is unresolved.

units.name: B00_RenderLevelEntities
units.summary: Render transient effects, level records and secondary records in that order. This renderer is duplicated in four physical level banks; CPU aliases do not identify the copy.

units.name: B00_RenderVisibleLevelRecords
units.summary: Scan 16 records backwards. Bit $20 enables rendering; subtract the 16-bit camera position from planar X/Y fields. The low type nibble selects the clipped vertical-chain draw consumer.

units.name: B00_NextLevelRecord
units.summary: Save the record index because the draw consumer can clobber X.

units.name: B00_AdvanceLevelRecord
units.summary: Continue with the preceding record; negative X terminates the scan.

units.name: B00_DrawLevelColumn
units.summary: Draw the level record as a clipped vertical chain. Bias X by 64; the low type nibble determines the number of eight-pixel rows and whether the first row uses the alternate template pair.

units.name: B00_NextLevelColumnRow
units.summary: Advance projected Y by eight, reject offscreen high bytes and rows below 167, then append the selected component. Decrease the remaining type count by two per row.

units.name: B00_RenderSecondaryRecords
units.summary: Scan the second 16-record array. Bit $02 marks visible records; convert its fifth plane to an eightfold index minus one before drawing. The quad draw body uses four clipped template components.

units.name: B00_NextSecondaryRecord
units.summary: Project the next secondary record into camera-relative coordinates.

units.name: B00_AdvanceSecondaryRecord
units.summary: Restore the saved record index and continue backwards.

units.name: B00_DrawSecondaryQuad
units.summary: Project four template components using local X/Y biases. Skip clipped components; the record's frame selector biases the paired template index.

units.name: B00_RenderTransientEffects
units.summary: Scan 16 effect slots. A negative type disables a slot; discard coordinates with nonzero camera-relative high bytes, then choose a draw path by effect type.

units.name: B00_NextEffect
units.summary: Preserve the slot while helpers use X for table indexing.

units.name: B00_AdvanceEffect
units.summary: Skip disabled, clipped or unsupported effect states.

units.name: B00_DrawEffectTypeZero
units.summary: Use the projected origin only above the lower clipping boundary. State 0 uses a lookup; state 2 selects a paired frame directly, while state 1 is skipped.

units.name: B00_SelectEffectLookupFrame
units.summary: Translate the effect frame through the local lookup, double it, and bias the draw index by minus one.

units.name: B00_DrawEffectTypeOne
units.summary: Choose the paired frame index for this effect; zero state takes the alternate fixed-index path.

units.name: B00_SelectEffectFixedFrame
units.summary: Use the zero-state draw index, biased by $13.

units.name: B00_DrawOtherEffectType
units.summary: State 4 uses the effect frame; other states take the shared fixed-index path. Exact visual meanings remain unresolved.

units.name: B00_SelectOtherEffectFixedFrame
units.summary: Use the alternate fixed draw index; The shared component writer appends the selected sprite to OAM.

units.name: B00_AppendTemplateSprite
units.summary: Read attribute/tile bytes after template cursor Y, combine flip bits, and append Y/tile/attribute/X to shadow OAM. Update the byte cursor and sprite count; temporary pushes preserve byte order.

units.name: B00_AbortOccludedLevelDraw
units.summary: When occlusion is enabled, preserve X and quantize sprite coordinates plus scroll into the 0600 visibility grid. FF returns normally; another cell value discards one caller return address. No natural caller is established.

units.name: B00_SkipOccludedLevelCaller
units.summary: Restore X, discard the immediate caller's return address, and return to its caller. This is a nonlocal draw abort, not a normal fallthrough.

units.name: B08_AudioResetVector
units.summary: Bank-local audio entry vectors: clear enable shadow, initialize a track in channel X, or tick channel X.

units.name: B08_AudioStartTrackVector
units.summary: Enter channel initialization with A as track selector and X as channel index.

units.name: B08_AudioTickChannelVector
units.summary: Advance one audio channel and update its APU registers.

units.name: B08_ClearAudioEnable
units.summary: Clear the software channel-enable mask.

units.name: B08_StartAudioTrack
units.summary: Double track ID for a word table, enable the selected hardware channel and reset its stream, envelope and modulation cursors. X must be a valid channel index.

units.name: B08_TickAudioChannel
units.summary: Skip disabled tracks. Channel 0/1 use pulse control, 2 triangle and 3 noise. Write timer high only when changed, avoiding unnecessary length/phase restarts; then advance duration and pattern streams.

units.name: B08_AudioTickReturn
units.summary: Disabled channel returns without touching its stream.

units.name: B08_WriteNoiseChannel
units.summary: Write noise volume and period through the four-register channel stride.

units.name: B08_WriteTriangleChannel
units.summary: Select triangle linear-counter control before the common register writer.

units.name: B08_WritePulseChannel
units.summary: Combine instrument duty bits with constant-volume/length-control bits.

units.name: B08_WriteAudioRegisters
units.summary: Y is channel index times four; low timer is always written, high timer only when its shadow changes.

units.name: B08_AdvanceAudioDuration
units.summary: Advance timing envelopes and note duration after the hardware update. Exact tempo units are engine ticks.

units.name: B08_ReadDurationStream
units.summary: Resolve the track timing word pointer and consume one duration byte; $FF restarts at the stream beginning.

units.name: B08_ReadPatternByte
units.summary: Resolve split low/high pattern pointers, then use the channel cursor. $FF returns to the track-selection stream.

units.name: B08_ReadTrackSequence
units.summary: Use a word-pointer track stream. $FF redirects its cursor; $FE stops the channel; high-bit bytes set transposition before the next pattern selector.

units.name: B08_FollowTrackRedirect
units.summary: Use the redirect cursor to read another track byte, then resume the common selector parser.

units.name: B08_InterpretTrackSelector
units.summary: A=$FE disables the channel. Values >=$80 set the seven-bit transpose and continue parsing; other values choose the next pattern.

units.name: B08_DecodeNoteCommands
units.summary: Decode $FD as a slide tuple, $E0-$FF as duration/rest, $C0-$DF as instrument, $80-$BF as duration, and $60-$7F as arpeggio selector. Lower values are notes plus transpose. These are consumer mechanics, not a complete stream-extent claim.

units.name: B08_DecodeDurationOrInstrument
units.summary: Packed ranges update duration or instrument before the following note.

units.name: B08_InitializeNote
units.summary: Commit stream cursor and decode the four-byte instrument record. Pulse channels recover duty bits; pitched channels map notes to timer bytes, while noise uses the note as its period directly.

units.name: B08_ResetNoteModulation
units.summary: Reload note duration and clear envelope, pitch and arpeggio cursors. A nonzero slide byte splits into step and delay nibbles.

units.name: B08_ApplyAudioModulation
units.summary: Apply volume-envelope bytes until $FE, then slide toward the target timer, apply signed pitch deltas, pulse duty sequence, and optional note-offset sequence. Stream terminators differ by consumer.

units.name: B08_SubtractSlideTarget
units.summary: Propagate the timer carry into its high byte before comparing with the target note timer. The shared continuation clamps a completed slide.

units.name: B08_SlideTimerDown
units.summary: Subtract slide step with high-byte borrow; clamp at the target note and stop sliding once reached.

units.name: B08_ApplyPitchSequence
units.summary: Without an active slide, select the signed pitch delta stream and wrap its cursor on $80.

units.name: B08_ApplyDutySequence
units.summary: Only pulse channels use the duty sequence. $FE holds, $FF supplies a replacement cursor, other bytes become duty bits.

units.name: B08_ApplyNoteOffsetSequence
units.summary: When instrument bit $40 is set, read note offsets; $FF changes the cursor and $FE holds. Noise uses the resulting value directly; other channels look up pitch timers.

units.name: B08_FinishNoteOffsetTick
units.summary: Join the audio update return without replacing the held pitch value.

units.name: B08_WriteArpeggioPitch
units.summary: Translate the offset note into low/high timer shadows and return.

units.name: B10_EnterScreenMode
units.summary: Install the screen NMI, clear mode scratch and dispatch A through eleven word entries. This call requires the screen pair in slots 8000/A000; the finite selectors are 0 through 10.

units.name: B10_RunTitleScreen
units.summary: Load title resource 1 and enable the screen NMI. Animate sprites and palette while waiting for input or timeout; timeout enters the rotating gameplay demonstration, while input enters the option menus.

units.name: B10_WaitTitleChoice
units.summary: The NMI updates controller state and frame timers while the foreground waits.

units.name: B10_RunTitleRasterTransition
units.summary: Queue title commands, install the raster handler and animate until its phase completes. Hide sprites, stop raster work, then choose the rotating demo stage.

units.name: B10_WaitTitleTimeout
units.summary: Wait for successive frame-counter intervals, fade out, then disable display for transition. The continuation initializes a rotating attract demo.

units.name: B10_SelectNextDemoStage
units.summary: Select one of four stage indices, advance the rotating selector modulo four, run the fixed demo helper, and reinstall the screen NMI before returning to the title.

units.name: B10_EnterDemoContinuation
units.summary: Transfer to the title continuation after the demonstration returns; restore the screen entry's title state through the common target.

units.name: B10_HideTitleSprites
units.summary: Hide every shadow OAM entry with F8, restore title colors, and synchronize queued screen commands before entering the foreground menu.

units.name: B10_ClearAndRedrawMenu
units.summary: Queue screen commands 4 then 5 and wait for NMI completion. Substep 5 controls the clearing work.

units.name: B10_WaitMenuCommandThree
units.summary: Queue command 3 and wait until the NMI clears it; foreground depends on screen interrupts continuing.

units.name: B10_RunTitleMenu
units.summary: Prepare option text and cursor, wait for user selection, then fade out and shut down screen mode.

units.name: B10_PollMainMenu
units.summary: Debounce for ten screen ticks. Up/down move a bounded four-row cursor; action returns on row zero, toggles two option bits on rows one/two, or opens the configuration menu.

units.name: B10_ToggleMenuAudio
units.summary: Toggle option bit 1. Turning audio on requests command 4 and waits for acknowledgement; turning it off uses the shared silence request.

units.name: B10_ToggleMenuOptionBitTwo
units.summary: Toggle option bit 2 and redraw. Its exact gameplay interpretation remains unresolved here.

units.name: B10_RedrawMainMenuAfterInput
units.summary: Queue the cursor/value redraw, wait for the held button to release, and resume debounced polling.

units.name: B10_EnterConfigurationMenu
units.summary: Reset sound-test selectors and menu cursor, clear old text, draw configuration rows and begin the five-row input loop.

units.name: B10_PollConfigurationMenu
units.summary: Up/down choose one of five rows. Action cycles difficulty, music, effect, or initial-life values; the last row restores the main menu.

units.name: B10_CycleDifficulty
units.summary: Cycle the three difficulty values modulo three and queue the value redraw.

units.name: B10_CycleInitialLives
units.summary: Cycle the initial-life value through 1 to 9. Current-run lives are copied from this setting when a game begins.

units.name: B10_CycleMusicTest
units.summary: Cycle fourteen music selectors. Silence first, then request selector plus four from the fixed audio-command table.

units.name: B10_CycleEffectTest
units.summary: Cycle 31 effect selectors, silence audio and clear the effect-test gate before requesting selector plus 19.

units.name: B10_RedrawConfigurationValues
units.summary: Queue command 9, wait for completion and button release, then resume configuration polling.

units.name: B10_AnimateTitleSprites
units.summary: Preserve X/Y. Every three countdown ticks advance a bounded animation counter, then use three eight-phase selectors to move sprite groups with tile IDs $28/$29/$2A.

units.name: B10_LiftTitleSpriteGroup
units.summary: Convert animation cursor progress to one through four four-sprite groups and raise those shadow OAM rows by one pixel.

units.name: B10_MoveTitleTile28
units.summary: Walk OAM entries from tile-byte offset $61 in strides of four; matching tiles move upward one pixel.

units.name: B10_MoveTitleTile29
units.summary: Move OAM group with tile $29 upward, preserving the other entries.

units.name: B10_MoveTitleTile2A
units.summary: Move OAM group with tile $2A upward.

units.name: B10_FadeTitlePalette
units.summary: Animate while waiting for six-tick palette intervals. Walk a 15-entry palette-index table, stepping colors through brightness bands; controller input unwinds this foreground wait to the title transition.

units.name: B10_UpdateScreenCommands
units.summary: NMI screen-command handler runs only in screen mode 1. Command and substep choose bounded PPU text/palette work; command 0 is idle. Foreground dispatch uses eleven finite entries.

units.name: B10_UploadBiasedTitleText
units.summary: Resolve a word pointer by substep; first two bytes form PPU address, following bytes terminate at $FF and receive tile bias $AA.

units.name: B10_CompleteScreenCommand
units.summary: Clear command and substep after the NMI finishes a text/palette task.

units.name: B10_ScreenCommandReturn
units.summary: No active screen command returns immediately.

units.name: B10_ScreenCommandTwo
units.summary: Initialize a black palette range on substep zero; subsequent substeps upload $FF-terminated text with tile bias minus $20, clearing command after substep eight.

units.name: B10_ScreenCommandThree
units.summary: On each timed palette step, copy four colors and advance substep. Five steps finish the command.

units.name: B10_ScreenPaletteThreeReturn
units.summary: Return after the palette step or when its timer has not elapsed.

units.name: B10_ScreenCommandFour
units.summary: Copy the corresponding four-color group in reverse substep order, then clear command/substep after the last group.

units.name: B10_ScreenPaletteFourReturn
units.summary: Return after the reverse palette step or while waiting for its timer.

units.name: B10_ScreenCommandFive
units.summary: Clear nine $40-byte PPU spans, then write $28 attribute bytes with $55 and clear command state.

units.name: B10_ScreenCommandSix
units.summary: Upload another bounded set of address-prefixed, $FF-terminated text records; subtract $20 from each character byte.

units.name: B10_ScreenCommandSeven
units.summary: Refresh two option toggles and move the selection marker using the previous/current option indices. Clear command when complete.

units.name: B10_ScreenCommandEight
units.summary: Upload five text substeps through a second word-pointer list, then clear command and substep.

units.name: B10_ScreenCommandNine
units.summary: Refresh difficulty/value fields and cursor tiles from option RAM. No meaning is assigned to untested individual option values.

units.name: B10_UnknownScreenCommandReturn
units.summary: Unrecognized command falls through to return.

units.name: B10_ShowMissionScreen
units.summary: Load resource zero, draw stage-specific mission text and the remaining-life digit, and request stage-start audio unless disabled. Run the short OAM animation while the timer/input gate holds, then fade out.

units.name: B10_DrawMissionText
units.summary: Resolve stage subtitle words, omit a FFFF optional field, upload the fixed labels, and display the current run's life count as a biased tile digit.

units.name: B10_UploadTextFromStart
units.summary: Set text cursor Y to zero and enter the FF-terminated minus-20 tile uploader. Callers supply the word pointer and PPU destination.

units.name: B10_UploadTextMinusSpace
units.summary: Copy through pointer $A0 until $FF, mapping text bytes to tiles by subtracting $20. Y is the starting offset.

units.name: B10_RequestAudioSilence
units.summary: Request audio command $12 and spin until the NMI consumes it and marks the request negative.

units.name: B10_DisableScreenMode
units.summary: Silence audio, disable display/NMI and clear screen-command/scroll state.

units.name: B10_TickScreenFade
units.summary: State 1/2 becomes an active fade; on four-tick intervals subtract the selected brightness bias from 32 source colors, replacing underflow with black. Clear fade state at its terminal step.

units.name: B10_TickMissionSpriteAnimation
units.summary: Every seven screen ticks, decrement the mission delay and cycle ten animation phases. Write four OAM Y positions using the local offset and frame tables.

units.name: B10_ShowTimedScreenTwo
units.summary: Load screen 2, fade in, wait $96 timer ticks, fade out and return through the common screen shutdown.

units.name: B10_ShowTimedScreenNine
units.summary: Same timed-screen contract for screen 9.

units.name: B10_ShowTimedScreenTen
units.summary: Same timed-screen contract for screen 10.

units.name: B10_ShowFailureScreen
units.summary: Load resource five with audio command 13. Hold briefly, then accept input or timeout before fading out and returning.

units.name: B10_EnterCompletionScreen
units.summary: Load resource eight and completion audio, fade in, then convert rescued counts, time and remaining resources into decimal score. Queue NMI text updates while foreground counters advance.

units.name: B10_AwardRescueBonus
units.summary: Count each remaining rescue into the temporary decimal counter and add five at the selected score digit, with short NMI-paced redraws.

units.name: B10_PrepareCompletionBonusText
units.summary: Invoke the completion counter clear and queue the next bonus text command before testing remaining time/resources.

units.name: B10_AwardTimeBonus
units.summary: If any time remains, advance the mixed-radix temporary time toward the HUD time while adding score. Refresh every ten increments until all four digits agree.

units.name: B10_AwardResourceBonuses
units.summary: Convert each nonzero resource pool into score, one count per paced redraw. The individual pool-to-weapon names remain unresolved; physical counters remain distinct.

units.name: B10_AwardModeAndDifficultyBonus
units.summary: After resource conversion, conditionally award the mode bonus and then the selected difficulty bonus before displaying the final subtotal.

units.name: B10_CommitCompletionScore
units.summary: Add six decimal subtotal digits to the accumulated score with right-to-left carry. Finish the fade and restore scroll before screen shutdown.

units.name: B10_WaitBonusPause
units.summary: Set a ten-tick animation timer and wait for the NMI to expire it.

units.name: B10_ClearBonusCounter
units.summary: Zero the temporary time and five-digit award counter. The caller separately supplies the PPU destination.

units.name: B10_IncrementBonusTime
units.summary: Advance the four-digit time counter with decimal units and a six-valued tens-of-seconds digit, carrying toward the most significant digit.

units.name: B10_IncrementBonusDecimal
units.summary: Increment the four-digit decimal work counter with carry, stopping when a digit stays below ten.

units.name: B10_AddBonusToSubtotal
units.summary: A is the award and X the digit. Add with decimal carry to both the award display and subtotal, preserving the original digit/award for the second pass.

units.name: B10_RequestBonusTickSound
units.summary: When the audio request is idle, choose the regular or alternate bonus-count sound from the screen sound gates.

units.name: B10_TickScreenEightCommands
units.summary: Only screen mode eight with a pending command enters the completion text/numeric uploader. Idle or other modes return immediately.

units.name: B10_UploadBonusCommand
units.summary: Commands 1 through 11 traverse address-prefixed FF text runs. Later commands render time, award digits or the six-digit subtotal directly; all character digits receive tile bias 10.

units.name: B10_ScreenEightReturn
units.summary: No active screen-eight work.

units.name: B10_DispatchBonusNumericCommand
units.summary: Decode the command relative to 12: time/award fields, formatted time, short numeric value, or subtotal. Leading zero award digits are skipped.

units.name: B10_ShowFinalScore
units.summary: Load score resource six. Compare six decimal digits from most significant to least and replace the high score only if current score exceeds it. Hold for input or bounded timer intervals, then fade out.

units.name: B10_UploadFinalAndHighScore
units.summary: Write six biased decimal digits for the retained high score and six for the current total at fixed PPU destinations.

units.name: B10_ShowScreenThree
units.summary: Load resource three, request audio 15, fade in for the fixed wait, then fade out and shut down.

units.name: B10_ShowAnimatedScreenSeven
units.summary: Load resource seven and audio 15, fade in, run the 128-step sprite animation, then hold and fade out.

units.name: B10_AnimateScreenSevenSprites
units.summary: Move the selected OAM rows by a per-tick delta for 128 ticks. At phases 90 and 110, replace thirteen tiles; the latter also shifts their X positions left by two.

units.name: B10_EnterEndingScreen
units.summary: Initialize the alternate nametable attributes, load ending resource four and audio 11, set the ending text cursor to 91B1, then install the ending raster sequence.

units.name: B10_WaitTextFinished
units.summary: Wait for the text routine's terminal flag, fade out, then shut down the screen.

units.name: B10_ScreenRasterIRQ
units.summary: Preserve A/X/Y, perform timed blanking, disable MMC3 IRQ, install scrolling PPU address and horizontal scroll, then restore rendering and registers. NOP/delay lengths are timing-sensitive.

units.name: B10_AdvanceEndingScroll
units.summary: Only phase 5 scrolls one pixel per tick, toggling the nametable bit on wrap. Every eight pixels upload one character of the next text row.

units.name: B10_UploadEndingCharacter
units.summary: Advance a 32-column cursor and source row pointer, select the nametable, subtract $20 from character values, and set the terminal flag on $FF. Exact message/source extents are not inferred here.

units.name: B10_ClearScreenAndPalette
units.summary: Reset PPU latch/scroll, clear eight pages starting at nametable $2000 and fill the 32-byte palette shadow with black.

units.name: B10_LoadScreenResources
units.summary: A selects parallel resource tables: tile stream, palette, attributes, OAM template and tile bias. Address-prefixed tile runs end at $FF; $FE switches to text conversion minus $20. Copy 64 attribute bytes and hide remaining OAM bytes after its sentinel.

units.name: B10_LoadNextTileRun
units.summary: Read low/high PPU address, then copy biased tiles until a sentinel; advance the stream pointer between runs.

units.name: B10_LoadTextTileRun
units.summary: In text mode convert character bytes by subtracting space until $FF.

units.name: B10_LoadScreenAttributes
units.summary: After tile runs, write attributes at $23C0, OAM template and a black initial palette.

units.name: B10_ScreenNMI
units.summary: Save A/X/Y, DMA OAM, upload 32 palette bytes, select CHR resources, run screen commands/IRQ preparation/scrolling/fade/input and audio. Increment frame timers and restore registers with RTI.

units.name: B10_ReadScreenController
units.summary: Latch controller 1 and rotate eight serial button bits into ControllerButtons.

units.name: B10_TitleRasterIRQ
units.summary: Preserve A/X/Y, delay to the split, blank rendering and select CHR register 1 value 54. Reset scroll/address state, disable IRQ, restore rendering and registers, then RTI. The bank write changes CHR only.

units.name: B10_InstallTitleRaster
units.summary: Install IRQ 9873, reset raster scroll/phase and begin with latch C8. This IRQ target is distinct from the ending split.

units.name: B10_InstallEndingRaster
units.summary: Install the ending IRQ, clear text/raster cursors and terminal flag, and start raster phase five with latch B4.

units.name: B10_ArmScreenIRQ
units.summary: An active screen raster phase loads MMC3 latch, reload and enable registers.

units.name: B10_UploadRasterRows
units.summary: For raster phases 1..3, upload 32 bytes at a table-selected PPU address and advance the phase.

units.name: B10_ClearEndingAttributes
units.summary: Write 24 zero attribute bytes at PPU 23C0 for the ending text area.

units.name: B10_AnimateTitleRasterWait
units.summary: Continue title sprite motion while raster phase advances. Then alter three palette colors and step the split position 24 times, checking controller escape during every wait.

units.name: B10_AbortTitleRasterOnInput
units.summary: Any held controller bit removes two return addresses and jumps to the menu sprite-hide entry. This deliberately exits both nested foreground waits.

units.name: B12_RenderActorSprites
units.summary: Alternate actor traversal direction each frame to distribute OAM priority. Render the player separately, then active slots 1..7. Store each slot's emitted-sprite count; clear unused OAM while capacity remains.

units.name: B12_RenderActorsAlternating
units.summary: Initialize CHR selectors and alternate ascending/descending actor order.

units.name: B12_SelectActorCHR
units.summary: A rendered actor of type $0D can select a CHR byte from frame-record offset 8. Other actor types leave the selector unchanged.

units.name: B12_RenderPlayerWithBlink
units.summary: Save OAM cursors, skip hidden player state, render slot zero and choose player CHR. During the blink interval, restore cursors on selected phases to discard emitted sprites.

units.name: B12_RenderActorSlot
units.summary: Skip inactive slots or null frame pointers. Resolve the actor's flags and frame pointer, choose CHR selector when applicable, update movement and select one of four flip combinations from actor/frame flags.

units.name: B12_ApplyFrameMotion
units.summary: When gameplay is active, apply signed frame offsets to 16-bit actor coordinates. Direction changes addition/subtraction; player motion also invokes the horizontal environmental displacement helper.

units.name: B12_ApplyOppositeFrameMotion
units.summary: Opposite facing adds X offset and subtracts Y offset instead of the other direction.

units.name: B12_RenderUnflippedFrame
units.summary: Subtract frame origin offsets from camera-relative coordinates. Four-byte sprite entries start at record offset $0B and terminate at $FF. Reject nonzero high-byte positions, Y >=$A6 and OAM count >=64 before emitting.

units.name: B12_NextUnflippedSprite
units.summary: Clip each component before writing one OAM entry; advance by four record bytes.

units.name: B12_ActorFrameReturn
units.summary: Frame terminator, clipping capacity or completion returns here.

units.name: B12_RenderVerticalFlip
units.summary: Project actor coordinates, apply the frame origins and draw the forward-X component path with vertical component subtraction and visibility clipping.

units.name: B12_DrawActorComponentsForward
units.summary: Apply frame origins to the 16-bit projected actor position, then walk four-byte components from header offset 11. Stop at FF or 64 emitted sprites; skip components outside the visible vertical area.

units.name: B12_NextForwardActorComponent
units.summary: Combine component X with the projected origin and subtract component Y. Reject nonzero high coordinates before appending OAM; advance the saved component cursor by four.

units.name: B12_RenderHorizontalFlip
units.summary: Add frame X origin then subtract tile width eight; subtract component X positions, preserve Y orientation and apply the same capacity/clipping rules.

units.name: B12_NextHorizontalFlipSprite
units.summary: Walk four-byte sprite components with mirrored X.

units.name: B12_HorizontalFlipReturn
units.summary: Return after the component sentinel or OAM capacity limit.

units.name: B12_RenderBothFlips
units.summary: Project actor coordinates, apply the mirrored X origin and subtract component offsets. The common OAM writer combines sprite flip bits with component attributes.

units.name: B12_DrawActorComponentsMirrored
units.summary: Prepare the mirrored X origin with an eight-pixel adjustment. Subtract component X instead of adding it; retain the same Y projection, clipping and four-byte stride.

units.name: B12_NextMirroredActorComponent
units.summary: Stop at FF or the OAM capacity. Project the mirrored component, append only visible sprites, then advance the cursor.

units.name: B12_EmitOAMComponent
units.summary: Read attribute and tile bytes from the frame record; XOR attributes with flip flags and append Y/tile/attribute/X to the OAM shadow. Advance byte and sprite counters.

units.name: B12_AbortOccludedActorDraw
units.summary: Preserve X and quantize screen position plus scroll through the fixed row-remap table into the 0600 visibility grid. Correct vertical carry by 16. FF returns normally; another value skips the caller. Static contract only; natural use is unresolved.

units.name: B12_SkipOccludedActorCaller
units.summary: Restore X and remove one caller return address before returning. Keep this stack effect when translating the renderer.

units.name: B12_ProjectActorToCamera
units.summary: Use render-slot-to-actor index to subtract the 16-bit camera origin from actor X/Y. Outputs are shared screen-coordinate scratch pairs.

units.name: B13_UploadStagePalette
units.summary: Map the current level resource bank into slot 8000 and copy 32 bytes from the stage palette pointer into the palette shadow. Slot A000 remains bank 13.

units.name: B13_DimGameplayPalette
units.summary: Subtract one brightness band from all 32 palette-shadow bytes; replace underflow with black.

units.name: B13_ConsumeSpawnFlag
units.summary: Use the active actor index minus three to check a pending flag, select its animation delay and clear the flag. The table's exact game meaning remains unresolved.

units.name: B13_TickFallingActor
units.summary: Probe terrain below the actor and retire it on contact. Otherwise advance Y by two or three according to its animation frame, retaining carry into the high coordinate.

units.name: B13_RetireFallingActor
units.summary: Clear the active slot and actor flags and move the actor's X high byte out of the active world window.

units.name: B13_AdvanceScriptedActorRoute
units.summary: For the selected route actor, consume the per-tick latch and decrement its signed route distance. At expiry, run the optional transition, decode the next route record and initialize its behavior; still perform player contact testing.

units.name: B13_UpdateActorHorizontalProbe
units.summary: Resolve actor from current active slot, test ground/material and compare its 16-bit X against a stored reference. Facing selects a left/right probe; dispatch effects when the probe accepts.

units.name: B13_ProbeActorLeft
units.summary: Skip a redundant probe for facing 4; otherwise sample $14 pixels left and return if blocked.

units.name: B13_MarkActorProbeState
units.summary: Set the actor-relative marker once if the earlier probe fails.

units.name: B13_AdvanceActorDownward
units.summary: Move the selected actor down two pixels and restart its animation at frame one with delay four.

units.name: B13_ActorProbeReturn
units.summary: Return without spawning further effects.

units.name: B13_EmitActorContactEffect
units.summary: A pending actor transition selects a spawn helper and then applies the decoded route action. Preserve route/active-slot indices across the local effect update.

units.name: B13_UpdateActorMotionState
units.summary: Project active slot to actor index. State 1 advances a 32-step vertical-motion table, while later states clear a per-actor motion field. Actor facing and collision probes constrain movement.

units.name: B13_ApplyActorVerticalCurve
units.summary: Index signed vertical steps by the actor's phase, add the 16-bit displacement and advance the bounded phase toward 32.

units.name: B13_ActorMotionReturn
units.summary: End the current state update.

units.name: B13_ResetActorMotionField
units.summary: At a short remaining delay clear the actor-relative motion phase, then continue the route action through the common dispatcher.

units.name: B13_ApplyActorHorizontalStep
units.summary: Add or subtract the actor's stored step from its 16-bit X according to facing four. Both carry and borrow update the high coordinate before terrain checks.

units.name: B13_TestActorLanding
units.summary: After motion step 16 optionally spawn an effect and clear its flag. Probe ground and special material; successful contact switches active-slot animation state to 2.

units.name: B13_RetireActorAtAnimationEnd
units.summary: At frame three with less than two delay ticks, deactivate the slot, reset its state and move it outside the active X window. Continue contact checking on other ticks.

units.name: B13_RetireSpecialActorFrameThree
units.summary: At the last delay tick of frame three, clear the slot and retire actor 1C. The exact visual effect represented by this reserved actor is unresolved.

units.name: B13_RetireSpecialActorFrameTwo
units.summary: Same reserved-actor retirement contract, triggered at frame two instead of three.

units.name: B13_CancelReservedActorSlot
units.summary: Search active slots 7 through 1 for actor index 1C and clear the matching slot. Return immediately after the first match.

units.name: B13_UpdateTimedAreaEffect
units.summary: Tick palette animation, set effect-active flag from its remaining resource, and derive an area origin relative to the player. On a timed pulse scan eligible active actors and dispatch the type-dependent consumer.

units.name: B13_PositionAreaEffect
units.summary: Store player position minus $0180 in both axes and decrement remaining resource at $32-tick intervals.

units.name: B13_AdvanceAreaEffectActor
units.summary: Continue scanning actor indices down to one. The matched handler performs the type-specific area effect and HUD marker update; maintain the saved scan index across calls.

units.name: B13_UpdateHUDMarkerFromActor
units.summary: Find the HUD OAM tile 34, replace it with tile 36 and position it from the current coarse actor offsets. Preserve caller X/Y around the sound request.

units.name: B13_AnimateEffectPalette
units.summary: Every three countdown ticks advance a 13-phase index and alternate palette bytes $34/$35 at four-byte intervals.

units.name: B13_EffectPaletteAlternate
units.summary: Write the alternate color for this pulse, then advance to the preceding palette entry.

units.name: B13_GetActorRelativeLookup
units.summary: Subtract the reference origin and quantize both coordinates into 32-pixel cells. Reject cells outside the interior window, fold each axis around the center and use the resulting local table index. Carry set returns a valid lookup byte; clear rejects.

units.name: B13_UpdateInventoryAndActors
units.summary: Process pickup/refill selection, health refill, weapon drain and timed-area effect in sequence.

units.name: B13_DrainWeaponMeter
units.summary: Drain the shared meter conditionally: selected weapon 8 can sustain it while fire is held; other cases drain on a four-tick countdown. Clear firing latch at zero.

units.name: B13_UpdateWeaponSelection
units.summary: Drain pending pickup work first. Select changes weapon only when the debounce expires and direction/fire bits are clear; format the chosen resource as decimal HUD digits.

units.name: B13_SelectNextAvailableWeapon
units.summary: Cycle nine selectors, skipping unavailable mask bits and empty resource pools. Commit a changed selection and restart debounce.

units.name: B13_ApplyPickupRefill
units.summary: While the pickup display timer is active, add bounded resource units on queued refill ticks and update decimal HUD output. Pickup type maps through a separate selector table.

units.name: B13_ApplyHealthRefill
units.summary: Increment health up to $18 while refill work remains, consuming a countdown and clearing its request at completion.

units.name: B13_ManageVisibleActorSlots
units.summary: Scan 32 actors. Cull off-camera ordinary actors while preserving special types; bind eligible visible actors to one of eight active animation slots and initialize their animation/render pointers.

units.name: B13_CullActorAgainstCamera
units.summary: Use 16-bit differences and margin windows rather than only low bytes. Actor zero and special actor types have different removal rules.

units.name: B13_AllocateActorSlot
units.summary: Search an inactive slot. Mark the actor when capacity is unavailable; otherwise install actor index, facing, initial state and delay.

units.name: B13_CommitActorSlot
units.summary: Initialize the actor-to-active-slot binding and both frame-pointer buffers under the copy-ready flag.

units.name: B13_AdvanceActorScan
units.summary: Advance actor index; stop at 32.

units.name: B13_MarkVisibleLevelRecords
units.summary: Scan 16 planar level records and set/clear bit $20 from camera-relative X/Y with a vertical cutoff. Disabled records keep their existing state.

units.name: B13_ClipLevelRecordBottom
units.summary: Clear visibility for low Y >=$AA; otherwise return to the visible case.

units.name: B13_TickLevelRecordState
units.summary: Skip disabled records and unsupported categories. A shared timer gates decrementing or incrementing the low type nibble according to direction bit 10, preserving upper flags and issuing endpoint sounds.

units.name: B13_BeginLevelRecordExpansion
units.summary: Toggle direction bit 10, force the low state active and set the short two-tick update delay.

units.name: B13_BeginLevelRecordContraction
units.summary: Toggle direction and decrement the packed record state, then set the eight-tick delay.

units.name: B13_FindActorLevelRecordContact
units.summary: Search enabled, nonnegative level records in reverse order. Require terminal low state, an accepted coordinate probe and one of two narrow horizontal contact windows; carry clear returns the selected record index.

units.name: B13_CompareActorWithLevelRecord
units.summary: Compare actor X/Y to planar record Y. Return carry clear inside the narrow vertical interval and carry set outside; preserve low coordinate differences in shared scratch.

units.name: B13_FindNearbyLevelRecord
units.summary: Search eligible level records backwards. Type >=3, coordinate window and actor facing choose contact side. Carry clear reports a selected contact with A as side; carry set means none.

units.name: B13_FindNearbyRecordWithFacing
units.summary: Alternate entry to the level-record search with facing already supplied in 0714. Reset the result latch, scan sixteen records backwards and return side/contact with carry clear.

units.name: B13_ToggleSelectedLevelRecord
units.summary: Preserve the active slot index while starting record expansion or contraction according to its current low nibble. Clear the selected-record latch.

units.name: B13_MarkVisibleSecondaryRecords
units.summary: Camera-relative culling for the second planar record array. Bit 0 disables and bit 1 records visibility; high-byte and lower-screen bounds reject offscreen entries.

units.name: B13_ClipSecondaryRecordBottom
units.summary: Clear visibility at Y >=$AA; restore the scan index through the loop.

units.name: B13_TestActiveSecondaryRecords
units.summary: Map active slot to actor, then test visible enabled secondary records through the bounded world-coordinate window helper. Carry clear returns the selected record index.

units.name: B13_AdvanceSecondaryCollision
units.summary: Restore current active slot after scanning and return carry set when no handler accepted.

units.name: B13_TestSecondaryRecordWindow
units.summary: Compare actor X against a secondary record within 18 pixels, and its Y against the eight-pixel support window. Carry set rejects; clear reports contact.

units.name: B13_CollectSecondaryRecord
units.summary: On accepted contact, read the record payload, mark its slot collected, add ten score units, request pickup audio and invoke the common collection continuation.

units.name: B13_ApplyPickupType
units.summary: Start the pickup display timer. Selector chooses a refill amount, resource unlock bits or health-refill work; an existing pickup is routed to the pending queue instead.

units.name: B13_AddScoreByte
units.summary: Convert unsigned A into hundreds/tens/units by repeated subtraction, then add into six unpacked decimal score digits with carry. The decimal digits are binary bytes, not packed BCD.

units.name: B13_TickSurvivalCounters
units.summary: Two cascaded countdowns decrement health at zero, clamped against negative wrap. The adjacent four-digit countdown borrows according to a radix table and clears all digits when exhausted.

units.name: B13_DecrementHUDTimeDigits
units.summary: Subtract through four digit positions with table-defined reload values; zero is the terminal display.

units.name: B13_TimeDigitsReturn
units.summary: Return after a successful decrement or terminal clear.

units.name: B13_UpdateHUDMeters
units.summary: Convert two values into three eight-unit meter segments using a tile table.

units.name: B13_BuildWeaponMeter
units.summary: Weapon meter units are consumed eight at a time; use a partial-segment table for the final remainder and empty tiles thereafter.

units.name: B13_WriteFullWeaponSegment
units.summary: Write a full meter segment while preserving remaining units on the stack; then restore the remainder and advance the bounded segment loop.

units.name: B13_ClearWeaponSegments
units.summary: Fill the remaining segment positions with the empty tile.

units.name: B13_BuildHealthMeter
units.summary: Render health in three eight-unit segments, sharing positions and partial-tile table with the other meter.

units.name: B13_WriteFullHealthSegment
units.summary: Write full health segments, then loop with the remaining units; empty trailing segments use tile $34.

units.name: B13_UploadGameplayHUDBackground
units.summary: Clear a PPU span, copy the fixed HUD tile strip, then write stage-dependent attribute bytes. Requires display-safe PPU access and bank 13 in slot A000.

units.name: B13_HandlePause
units.summary: Start enters pause only when no fade is active. Dim palette, wait for Start release and debounce, process the ten-step pause shortcut, then require Start press/release before resuming and restoring palette.

units.name: B13_CheckPauseShortcut
units.summary: Compare each released controller state to the ten-byte shortcut. Matching steps require a five-tick hold/release boundary. Complete match clears pause, fades out and enters the transition tail; mismatch resets progress.

units.name: B13_AdvanceStageFromPauseShortcut
units.summary: Disable display and IRQ, clear runtime objects, increment the stage and remove two return addresses before restarting at the fixed stage entry. This bypasses the ordinary completion test.

units.name: B13_ResetShortcutProgress
units.summary: A mismatched shortcut input restarts at index zero.

units.name: B13_ClearTransitionObjects
units.summary: Clear shadow OAM/work spans, level and secondary record flags, and the player slot before a transition.

units.name: B13_TickGameplayTimersAndFade
units.summary: Unless the player is in terminal state $1D, update survival/time counters and blink flag. Decrement bounded per-effect/cooldown timers, then process the gameplay palette fade under the selected level bank.

units.name: B13_TickGameplayFade
units.summary: Fade state 1/2 activates direction and initial step; five-tick intervals adjust 32 source palette colors, clamping dark values to black.

units.name: B13_FinishEffectUpdate
units.summary: Return to the effect dispatcher after the preceding selected behavior finishes. This accepted one-byte continuation retains its caller context; it is not evidence for unrelated isolated return bytes.

units.name: B13_ActivateActorNearPlayer
units.summary: Gate ordinary actors by proximity and type/state. Some actors move four pixels according to facing before the shared terrain collision helper; inactive actors can be reactivated by their record field.

units.name: B13_ActivateActorLeftStep
units.summary: Subtract four from actor X with high-byte borrow, then run the shared terrain movement helper.

units.name: B13_ActivateActorFromRecord
units.summary: Read planar record field $A0 and require its proximity test before setting actor-active bit.

units.name: B13_ProbeEffectTwoHeights
units.summary: Probe the effect at X plus four at two vertical sample points eight pixels apart, then resolve its tile/material response through the common bank-restoring helper.

units.name: B13_ProbeEffectLowerPoint
units.summary: Alternate entry to the two-height effect probe. Build X plus four and Y plus eight from the effect, resolve the world cell and tail-call the bank-restoring material response.

units.name: B13_ProbeEffectSide
units.summary: Choose X plus six or the raw X according to effect direction, add four to Y and probe the resulting world cell.

units.name: B13_ProbeEffectOrigin
units.summary: Probe at effect X plus four and its unmodified Y, then restore the level resource bank through the shared material helper.

units.name: B13_TestEffectActorBox
units.summary: Build a 24 by 24 box around the effect. Map frame bank 12 to build active actor rectangles, restore the level bank before damage dispatch, and stop at an accepted target. Restore mapping on the no-hit exit too.

units.name: B13_TestPlayerAttackBox
units.summary: For the supported player attack states, build a facing-dependent 32 by 16 box beside the player. Scan active actor rectangles with bank 12 temporarily mapped and tail-dispatch accepted attack damage after restoring the level bank.

units.name: B13_TickVerticalActorContact
units.summary: Near frame end copy slot facing into actor facing. Test player collision, resolve vertical terrain motion and retain the resulting direction in the active slot.

units.name: B13_ResolveVerticalActorMotion
units.summary: Probe above or below from the current direction. On success, move the actor four pixels and set direction 1 or 3; an obstructed probe discards one caller return address.

units.name: B13_AbortVerticalActorUpdate
units.summary: Discard the immediate caller return address so an obstructed vertical motion skips its remaining behavior.

units.name: B13_ActivateTallActor
units.summary: For an active actor, test the taller packed proximity bound and invoke the existing frame/contact continuation when accepted.

units.name: B13_TickInactiveVerticalActor
units.summary: Only state-zero actors move. Apply a two-pixel Y step in the selected direction, then use the shared four-pixel terrain correction/direction helper.

units.name: B13_ActivateTallActorFromRecord
units.summary: Use the taller actor's stage record to choose its proximity activation and terrain/contact continuation.

units.name: B13_AlignPlayerToSupport
units.summary: Unless excluded by player state/frame, adjust player Y at an eight-pixel boundary and align its low nibble to A. This is geometric alignment; the support object's visual name remains unresolved.

units.name: B13_CheckPlayerSecondaryContact
units.summary: Test secondary records for player slot zero; invoke follow-up only if the collision result accepts it. Pending pickup types are stored by the adjacent helper.

units.name: B13_QueuePickup
units.summary: Store the new pickup type at the current queue index, increment the queue cursor and return.

units.name: B13_PopPendingPickup
units.summary: Pop the latest queued pickup selector. Discard the caller return address before tail-jumping to pickup application; this deliberate nonlocal return matters to callers.

units.name: B13_TickActorFullContact
units.summary: Near frame end synchronize facing, then perform player damage/contact tests and terrain movement; store the resulting direction.

units.name: B13_FinishActorTurn
units.summary: Near animation end choose the left/right terrain correction from slot facing, write the resulting direction, and reset actor state/frame to zero.

units.name: B13_SpawnActorSideAttachment
units.summary: If reserved actor 1B is free, initialize it beside the selected actor using facing-dependent X plus/minus 16 and Y minus four. Reset the attachment state; its exact visual identity remains unresolved.

units.name: B13_RaisePlayerThenRecover
units.summary: Move player Y upward one pixel; once the animation has advanced from frame zero, enter the shared recovery state.

units.name: B13_CheckActorCloseAttack
units.summary: At a narrow frame-delay window, require player hit eligibility and a close actor/player distance. Enter player state 1E and reset its frame/delay, with a short motion timer.

units.name: B13_CycleLevelPalette
units.summary: When neither fade nor pause is active, selected stages rotate three palette colors every fourth timer interval.

units.name: B13_CheckStageExit
units.summary: Use stage-indexed 16-bit target coordinates. If player X/Y are each within a $20-wide unsigned window, enter the ordinary completion tail; otherwise return.

units.name: B13_UpdateEnvironmentalMotion
units.summary: Only at eight-pixel Y alignment, sample terrain on both sides of the player. Two signed material results select displacement direction/state or adjust X by four before switching falling states. Material meanings remain tentative.

units.name: B13_SampleTerrainLeft
units.summary: Sample player X minus four; shared routine probes Y plus $10 and derives a material response from mask/bit tests.

units.name: B13_SampleTerrainRight
units.summary: Sample player X plus four through the same material classifier.

units.name: B13_ClassifyTerrainSample
units.summary: Convert world coordinates to a banked map pointer, read tile material and test subcell mask. Return 0 for no effect, 1 or $FF for opposite responses selected by a second table.

units.name: B13_TestRectangleOverlap
units.summary: Expand each saved origin by a margin and compare 16-bit X/Y differences against combined extents. Carry set means overlap; clear means separated.

units.name: B13_PushPlayerOffSupport
units.summary: Move player down six pixels and eight horizontally according to facing; shared by support/contact transitions.

units.name: B13_ProbeAbovePlayer
units.summary: Sample player Y minus ten and delegate low tile types to the fixed collision-mask helper. Other types return carry clear.

units.name: B13_TickHeldWeaponAction
units.summary: Update facing from left/right input. While fire is held, pace resource consumption and audio by the action cooldown; exhausted/released fire enters a recovery animation. Active fire tests the player attack box.

units.name: B13_SpawnDirectedEffect
units.summary: Allocate an effect or nonlocally abort on exhaustion. Initialize its lifetime/type, choose direction and launch offsets from player state/facing, then request firing audio.

units.name: B13_InitializeSimpleEffect
units.summary: Set effect type one, state zero and lifetime one. Convert player facing into a compact direction index and return its doubled table index in X.

units.name: B13_FireResourcePool074C
units.summary: Require cooldown zero and a nonzero resource. Allocate and position the simple effect at a facing-dependent X and state-dependent Y offset, consume one unit and request sound. Empty stock imposes a longer retry delay.

units.name: B13_DispatchHeldWeapon
units.summary: Require action cooldown zero and dispatch the selected weapon: one path checks its stock and spawns a directed effect, another enters player state 20, and selector two uses pool 074C. Exact original weapon names remain tentative.

units.name: B13_TickDownHeldWeapon
units.summary: Update facing and require down plus fire to sustain the action. Pace resource use and the attack box; releasing inputs selects recovery or idle.

units.name: B13_InitializeStageActorRoutes
units.summary: Restore the level bank and load up to two route stream pointers from stage-specific fixed tables. Decode the first record of each nonnull stream.

units.name: B13_ReadActorRouteRecord
units.summary: A selects one of two streams and Y its byte cursor. Negative first byte wraps to the stream start; read action, transition flag and a little-endian target/distance word, then save the next cursor.

units.name: B13_ApplyActorRouteAction
units.summary: Map the decoded action to idle/moving/turning behavior, reset frame/delay and initialize facing and quantized route distance as required.

units.name: B13_FaceActorTowardRouteTarget
units.summary: Compare the route target word with actor X and set facing left or right in both actor and slot state.

units.name: B13_QuantizeActorRouteDistance
units.summary: Compute facing-dependent unsigned horizontal distance to the route target, divide by 32 and store its coarse route count.

units.name: B13_SpawnActorEffects
units.summary: Search five effect actor slots for inactive entries. Copy facing and spawn offset X +/-12 and Y minus eight, reset state and set pending flag. Full allocation failure queues audio $24.

units.name: B13_SpawnEffectToRight
units.summary: Complete the right-facing spawn coordinate with carry, then initialize Y/state/flag and continue scanning.

units.name: B13_ApplyEffectDamageToGuardian
units.summary: Ignore terminal state three. Subtract the selected effect's damage from the actor health byte; borrow triggers the fixed defeat/reward helper. Carry set reports an accepted hit.

units.name: B13_ApplyAttackDamageToGuardian
units.summary: Ignore terminal state three, otherwise subtract one health unit and invoke the defeat/reward helper on borrow. Carry set reports acceptance.

units.name: B14_EnterScreenBank
units.summary: Map physical PRG pair 8/9 through the supported mapper helper and jump to its CPU $8000 entry.

units.name: B14_MapPRGPair
units.summary: Y is the effective first 8-KiB PRG bank. Write MMC3 registers 6 and 7 with Y and Y+1. This helper assumes the established PRG mode; register indices are not bank IDs.

units.name: B14_ProbeNeighborMaterials
units.summary: Sample actor origin and three adjacent map bytes. Switch from map bank to material bank, compare sentinels and return carry according to the center/flanking combination.

units.name: B14_ProbeActorRight
units.summary: Add A to actor X, use actor Y plus ProbeYOffset, translate world coordinates and test material. Carry result comes from the fixed mask consumer for tile types below $0E.

units.name: B14_SetProbeY
units.summary: Store 16-bit actor Y plus ProbeYOffset into probe-coordinate scratch.

units.name: B14_ProbeActorLeft
units.summary: Subtract A from actor X using incoming carry, then share the right-probe map/material path. Callers must establish the subtraction carry contract.

units.name: B14_SetProbeX
units.summary: Copy actor X to shared 16-bit probe scratch.

units.name: B14_ProbeActorBelow
units.summary: Set X to actor origin, Y plus $10, then scan an $FF-terminated special-tile list. Carry clear means tile appears in the list; carry set means absent.

units.name: B14_CheckSpecialTileList
units.summary: World/map translation precedes an $FF-sentinel list lookup in the level-resource bank.

units.name: B14_ProbeActorSpecialCellAbove
units.summary: Require X on the appropriate half-cell, sample the world 32 pixels above the actor and search the FF-terminated special-tile list. Carry clear reports a matching tile; restore the level resource bank before the list read.

units.name: B14_ProbeActorMaterialAbove
units.summary: Sample 22 pixels above actor X, resolve the world tile and map it through the material table. FF rejects with carry set; other material values return carry clear.

units.name: B14_ProbeActorMaterialBelow
units.summary: Apply the caller's vertical offset, resolve the world tile and material, and report FF as carry set. Restore the level bank before consuming material data.

units.name: B14_ProbeActorOffsetLeft
units.summary: Subtract the supplied X offset and enter the common horizontal material probe. Y and the carry convention come from that shared consumer.

units.name: B14_ProbeOffsetMaterialMask
units.summary: Sample actor X plus scratch offset and its Y origin. $FF is solid; packed $33/$CC masks select a horizontal half-cell based on world X bit $10. Return carry as collision result.

units.name: B14_SetProbeYOffset
units.summary: Add A to actor Y and store the 16-bit result; shared by collision probes.

units.name: B14_ProbeActorRightEight
units.summary: Use actor X plus eight with caller-provided Y offset, then enter material-mask sampling.

units.name: B14_ProbeActorOffsetLeftEight
units.summary: Apply the caller's vertical offset and sample eight pixels left before joining the common probe. This is an accepted entry, not the earlier unresolved placeholder.

units.name: B14_ProbeActorMaterial
units.summary: Use actor origin and A as Y offset, resolve banked map byte and material mask, then choose one of eight subcell bits from X bit 4 and vertical low bits. Carry set denotes collision.

units.name: B14_TestPlayerSubcellMask
units.summary: Resolve the player's sample tile, search paired tile/mask records, form a 4 by 4 subcell index and mirror its column when bit 80 is set. A nonzero fixed mask reports carry set.

units.name: B14_ProbeSpecialNeighbor
units.summary: Search the FF-terminated special tile list, constrain subcell position and read the neighboring byte in the map bank. Restore level mapping before returning the final material decision.

units.name: B14_ResolveActorTileCollisionMask
units.summary: Read the sampled map tile, restore level mapping, translate through tile type then fixed collision-mask tables. Nonzero collision reports carry set.

units.name: B14_ProbePlayerSpecialPair
units.summary: Probe player Y+$10, scan tile/value pairs until $FF and apply an additional vertical-half check when the paired flag is nonzero.

units.name: B14_DispatchInactiveActors
units.summary: Scan actors 31 down to one whose flags 0E are clear. Actor type selects one of fifteen bounded initializer entries; their static handler contracts are established independently of pointer values.

units.name: B14_DispatchActorType
units.summary: Index the banked word table by twice actor type; tail-jump through the resulting pointer. A pointer alone is not code evidence for other entries.

units.name: B14_TickActiveActorSlots
units.summary: Scan slots 7..1, calling the animation/state update for active slots.

units.name: B14_TickActorSlot
units.summary: Map bank 12, resolve frame/state tables and save the next frame pointer; restore the level resource bank, then dispatch behavior by type and state.

units.name: B14_StageFramePointer
units.summary: Write the resolved frame pointer to the pending buffer with copy-ready flag cleared; set it after both bytes are written for NMI copying.

units.name: B14_ResolveActorFrame
units.summary: Actor type selects a state table; actor state selects a frame sequence; active-slot frame index selects the current frame record.

units.name: B14_AdvanceActorFrame
units.summary: Decrement delay, advance frame on underflow and recognize a $FFFF pair as state-transition marker followed by replacement actor state. Load the next frame's delay byte.

units.name: B14_DispatchActorBehavior
units.summary: Resolve type/state through a second nested pointer table and tail-jump to the selected behavior. All fifteen actor-type domains have matched frame and behavior state counts; natural selection of individual states remains separate.

units.name: B14_TickActorCollisionVariant
units.summary: Copy facing near the end of a frame, then call actor/player collision and terrain movement helpers.

units.name: B14_TickActorContactVariant
units.summary: Near frame end copy facing; test player overlap, additional contact constraints and terrain movement.

units.name: B14_TriggerCloseActorStateTwo
units.summary: Near animation end, require an eligible player state and close distance window. Reset the actor to state two/frame zero/delay five when accepted.

units.name: B14_ResetActorAfterTerrainMove
units.summary: Check contact, synchronize facing near frame end, move against terrain and retain the result. Reset actor state and animation frame for the next behavior.

units.name: B14_ChooseActorNearPlayerState
units.summary: Use relative position to choose a close-range state-five animation or reverse direction through the shared facing helper.

units.name: B14_TickActorFallUntilContact
units.summary: Until frame three, move actor downward two pixels and probe support. Contact aligns Y, enters the terminal frame/delay and plays landing audio; terminal frames use player contact testing.

units.name: B14_CanPlayerBeHit
units.summary: Lookup by player state; require a nonzero entry and no blink timer. Carry set means player hit tests are enabled.

units.name: B14_TestActorHitsPlayer
units.summary: Respect hit enable and optional per-slot emitted-sprite count. Map frame bank for both collision rectangles, restore level bank and test overlap; accepted collision delegates damage behavior.

units.name: B14_ApplyPlayerDamageTwo
units.summary: Tail-call the common saturating health subtraction with damage two.

units.name: B14_ReactPlayerToActorHit
units.summary: Mark contact, request hit audio and choose reaction by player eligibility state and relative facing. Reset animation and delay, with special-mode and airborne recovery alternatives.

units.name: B14_TestActorPlayerContact
units.summary: Gate contact through player-hit eligibility, active actors and relative position/facing windows; accepted terrain contact can invoke additional behavior.

units.name: B14_AcceptActorPlayerContact
units.summary: On an accepted relative-position window, reset actor frame/state and discard caller return addresses. Actor type 0C creates the reserved side attachment and uses a longer delay. These are intentional nonlocal exits.

units.name: B14_ActorContactReturn
units.summary: No accepted collision/contact returns here.

units.name: B14_HasBlockingActor
units.summary: Search active slots 7..1 for actor type 7 or type 2 in an early state. Carry set reports a blocker.

units.name: B14_HasActorTypeFiveBlocker
units.summary: Search active slots for actor type five in state three or above. Carry set reports a blocker; clear means none found.

units.name: B14_MoveActorAgainstTerrain
units.summary: Choose directional ground/side probes from facing; accepted movement can unwind the caller return with PLA/PLA/RTS. Otherwise invoke alternate actor behavior or contact continuation. Do not treat these as ordinary local returns.

units.name: B14_AbortActorTerrainCaller
units.summary: Discard one caller return address before returning from terrain rejection.

units.name: B14_ResolveActorRightTerrain
units.summary: Set actor Y for the right-side movement response; accepted support returns without correction, while obstruction can shift the actor or abort the caller.

units.name: B14_FaceActorLeft
units.summary: Set actor facing four and return after the terrain response.

units.name: B14_ShiftActorLeftEight
units.summary: Subtract eight from the actor's 16-bit X coordinate.

units.name: B14_ResolveActorLeftTerrainEntry
units.summary: Apply the mirrored side probe, then combine support/material/ground checks through the common left-terrain response.

units.name: B14_ResolveActorLeftTerrain
units.summary: Combine side, support, material and ground probes. Keep the current motion when accepted; otherwise shift right and face right through the shared correction.

units.name: B14_CorrectActorRightFacing
units.summary: Move actor right eight pixels and set facing two.

units.name: B14_ShiftActorRightEight
units.summary: Add eight to the actor's 16-bit X coordinate, preserving carry.

units.name: B14_RetireActorAtFrameFour
units.summary: At frame four, mark the actor retired in its flags and clear its active slot.

units.name: B14_ActivateActorFromStageRecord
units.summary: Mark actor active, read its stage proximity parameter and use the common position window. Accepted activation enters state one and may spawn a reserved actor at its position.

units.name: B14_RetireActorAtFrameTwo
units.summary: At frame two, set the retired flag and clear the active slot.

units.name: B14_SpawnReservedActorAtPosition
units.summary: Choose free reserved actor 1D or 1E, copy source coordinates and face toward the player. Initialize flags/state and request spawn audio; leave occupied slots unchanged.

units.name: B14_ApplyActorRisingCurve
units.summary: On animation-delay transitions, subtract a local vertical step and advance the bounded phase. After eight steps run the close-contact state transition, then continue horizontal terrain checks.

units.name: B14_TickActorGroundedPursuit
units.summary: Check close contact, side and support probes. Choose a landing/turn state when obstructed, move down two pixels across an accepted step, or enter the shared hit reaction on a material collision.

units.name: B14_ReverseActorAtAnimationEnd
units.summary: At the last delay tick, toggle left/right facing in the slot and actor record.

units.name: B14_TickActorAttachedToPlayer
units.summary: Copy player coordinates and opposite facing into the actor. At later frames either apply periodic contact damage during player state 17 or enter the next actor state with a small Y shift.

units.name: B14_CopyPlayerPositionToActor
units.summary: Copy all four position planes and choose the facing opposite the player in both actor and slot records.

units.name: B14_TickAttachedActorDamage
units.summary: Advance a modulo-64 counter. On wrap apply two player damage; zero health enters the fixed life-loss flow.

units.name: B14_TickActorFallAndTurn
units.summary: Pace a downward step by animation delay, test terrain/support, then align Y and enter state one on contact. Otherwise use the common side-probe direction reversal.

units.name: B14_AddActorYByte
units.summary: Add A to the selected actor's 16-bit Y coordinate and return.

units.name: B14_CheckActorForwardTerrain
units.summary: Probe the facing-selected side with a ten-pixel offset; obstruction enters the shared direction reversal.

units.name: B14_ReverseActorFacing
units.summary: Toggle actor/slot facing between two and four. Used by movement and pursuit behaviors after an obstructed probe.

units.name: B14_TriggerActorCloseContact
units.summary: At a late animation phase, reject blockers and require a narrow player-relative position/facing window. Enter actor state four and nonlocally skip its caller's remaining movement.

units.name: B14_EnterActorPlayerHold
units.summary: Require an eligible player facing opposite the actor inside a close window. Enter actor state six and player state 17, initialize a shared escape counter and retain controller state; rejection enters actor state five.

units.name: B14_TickSlowActorFall
units.summary: Move actor down one pixel, probe support and side obstruction, and enter state eight with aligned Y and landing audio on contact.

units.name: B14_TestActorPlayerFrameOverlap
units.summary: Temporarily map frame bank 12 to build both rectangles, restore the level bank and test overlap. On timeout reset actor behavior; on collision tail-dispatch the fixed hit response.

units.name: B14_DeactivateActorAtFrameFour
units.summary: Clear actor flags and its active slot when the animation reaches frame four.

units.name: B14_CheckPlayerActorProximity
units.summary: For an active actor, use the packed 88 proximity bound. Rejected actors are deactivated; accepted ones continue through the player-frame overlap test.

units.name: B14_PlayerActorProximityReturn
units.summary: Return when the actor is inactive.

units.name: B14_CheckActorCollectibleOverlap
units.summary: Unless player state 1D suppresses collection, build actor/player frame rectangles using bank 12 and restore the level bank before overlap testing. Acceptance enters collection state, adds 150 score units and requests sound.

units.name: B14_TickCollectibleFalling
units.summary: Hold a long animation delay, move down two pixels and probe support. Contact aligns Y, starts state two and a 70-tick retirement timer with landing audio.

units.name: B14_RetireCollectibleAfterTimer
units.summary: When the retirement timer expires, mark actor retired, clear its slot and update remaining/collected counters.

units.name: B14_MarkActorCollectedAtFrameThree
units.summary: Near the end of frame three, set the retired flag once and decrement the remaining count.

units.name: B14_SetPlayerIdleState
units.summary: Clear player state/frame/facing, set movement speed selector 2 and return.

units.name: B14_EnterPlayerSupportState
units.summary: If the support probe succeeds, reset player frame, enter state four and choose movement speed two; otherwise return to idle.

units.name: B14_EnterPlayerState0C
units.summary: Enter state 0C with no movement facing, frame zero, delay eight and a transition sound.

units.name: B14_SetPlayerAirborneState
units.summary: Set player state $0D with initial delay 8, clear frame and movement index, retain only facing 2/4 and copy it to active-slot facing. Exact animation meaning is tentative.

units.name: B14_EnterPlayerState0B
units.summary: Reset player frame/facing and enter state 0B with delay ten.

units.name: B14_EnterPlayerState08
units.summary: Enter state eight, reset frame/movement facing, choose slot facing one and movement speed two.

units.name: B14_EnterPlayerState09
units.summary: Enter state nine with the interaction latch set, facing one and speed two. Align X to its 32-pixel cell plus 12.

units.name: B14_EnterPlayerState0A
units.summary: Enter state 0A, clear frame/movement facing, set delay twelve/speed two and align the selected Y to eight pixels.

units.name: B14_SetPlayerState0E
units.summary: Set state $0E, reset frame, load delay $0C and movement speed selector 3.

units.name: B14_SetPlayerState0F
units.summary: Same transition initialization for alternate state $0F.

units.name: B14_EnterPlayerState10
units.summary: Enter state 10, reset frame and motion timer, set animation delay five and movement speed three. Its exact original animation name remains unresolved.

units.name: B14_EnterPlayerState13
units.summary: Set the interaction latch and enter state 13 with frame zero, delay ten and movement speed one.

units.name: B14_EnterPlayerState14
units.summary: Set interaction latch/speed one, enter state 14 and reset frame/delay.

units.name: B14_HandlePlayerStanding
units.summary: Probe moving support/ground and update environmental motion. Poll weapon input and directional/jump/crouch bits, entering the appropriate facing/probe/state path.

units.name: B14_PlayerLeftInput
units.summary: Face left and probe eight pixels left. A clear probe enters support handling; rejection preserves the current state.

units.name: B14_PlayerRightInput
units.summary: Set facing 2 and probe eight pixels right.

units.name: B14_PlayerUpInput
units.summary: Probe the upward special material. A clear result enters state eight; otherwise search an eligible level record and enter state 0C on contact.

units.name: B14_PlayerJumpInput
units.summary: Choose facing from horizontal input before entering airborne state; neutral clears facing. Down input checks support/material before entering the alternate state transition.

units.name: B14_PlayerDownState
units.summary: Tail-call the down-state transition after its probe accepts; probe rejection returns through the common input exit.

units.name: B14_ToggleRecordAtPlayerFrameTwo
units.summary: At player frame two, if the selected level-record index is valid, invoke the record expansion/contraction toggle.

units.name: B14_HandlePlayerWalking
units.summary: Update support and terrain probes, then poll weapon and jump input. Facing selects horizontal side probe; lost support returns to airborne/idle transitions.

units.name: B14_WalkingRightProbe
units.summary: Probe right only while right is held; otherwise return to idle.

units.name: B14_WalkingLostSupport
units.summary: Enter airborne state; The adjacent short fragment retains its separate unknown role.

units.name: B14_AlignPlayerX
units.summary: If low X nibble differs from 4, align position to a 32-pixel cell plus four.

units.name: B14_UpdatePlayerFallingArc
units.summary: Advance the falling timer and apply indexed vertical/horizontal displacement. Facing chooses mirrored horizontal steps; subcell contact can reverse facing. Ground/support contact aligns Y and selects normal recovery or a damage reaction based on fall duration.

units.name: B14_UpdateRightFacingFallingArc
units.summary: Mirror horizontal integration and material response for right-facing motion, retaining the same landing and fall-duration checks.

units.name: B14_FinishPlayerFallingArc
units.summary: Align Y to eight pixels. A long fall enters the delayed recovery frame, plays impact audio and removes one health unit; a short fall selects the normal airborne recovery.

units.name: B14_HandlePlayerDirectionalState
units.summary: Process weapon availability, then directional input with stage-mode-specific collision paths. Idle input clears facing and restores short delay.

units.name: B14_SetPlayerDirectionThree
units.summary: Avoid resetting the current animation unnecessarily; otherwise set facing 3 and restart frame delay.

units.name: B14_NudgePlayerDownOnProbe
units.summary: For an accepted directional probe, advance player Y one pixel and return to the common direction update.

units.name: B14_SetPlayerDirectionOne
