units.summary: Select facing 1 and restart its frame delay if changed.

units.name: B14_PlayerStateLeftProbe
units.summary: Probe the left material and reject the excluded subcell/ground combinations before entering the step state.

units.name: B14_CheckPlayerLeftStepState
units.summary: Reject the excluded subcell bit and require ground plus a clear left-side probe before entering state 0A facing left.

units.name: B14_PlayerStateRightProbe
units.summary: Mirror the directional material and ground checks before entering the right-facing step state.

units.name: B14_CheckPlayerRightStepState
units.summary: Mirror the step-state probe for right input, then enter state 0A facing right.

units.name: B14_HandleAlternateDirectionalState
units.summary: Poll all four directions in the alternate movement mode. No direction clears movement and restores delay two; accepted side actions use the subcell eligibility helper before changing state.

units.name: B14_SetAlternateFacingUp
units.summary: Set facing one and restart animation delay only when direction changed.

units.name: B14_AlternateLeftProbe
units.summary: Probe 32 pixels left, then require the subcell action window before entering the facing-specific action state.

units.name: B14_EnterAlternateLeftAction
units.summary: Require both the directional probe and subcell eligibility, then face left and enter state 14.

units.name: B14_AlternateRightProbe
units.summary: Probe 32 pixels right through the material-mask helper, then test the shared subcell eligibility window.

units.name: B14_EnterAlternateRightAction
units.summary: Require both probes, then face right and enter state 14.

units.name: B14_AlternateDownProbe
units.summary: Probe 16 pixels below; acceptance sets facing three and restarts animation only when direction changes.

units.name: B14_SetAlternateFacingDown
units.summary: On successful downward probe, change facing to three and restart the delay only if needed.

units.name: B14_CheckPlayerSubcellAction
units.summary: Accept only the middle subcell bands. One band additionally sets the interaction latch and raises Y eight pixels; carry set reports acceptance.

units.name: B14_DirectionalStateReturn
units.summary: Return from a completed directional update.

units.name: B14_CheckConsumableFire
units.summary: Require fire input, nonzero pool 074E, zero cooldown and an allocatable effect slot. Accepted fire initializes the effect and consumes one unit.

units.name: B14_ConsumableFireReturn
units.summary: Return when input/resource/cooldown rejects firing.

units.name: B14_SpawnResourcePool074EEffect
units.summary: Initialize effect type three at player X minus four and current Y, set lifetime/cooldowns and consume stock. Optionally queue selector six as the pickup/weapon change according to current gates.

units.name: B14_TickPlayerEscapeInputs
units.summary: Find a reserved actor in hold state six. Distinct controller changes decrement the escape counter; zero or loss of the holder returns player to idle. Counter bit three alternates displayed facing.

units.name: B14_TickPlayerDownFire
units.summary: While down remains held, keep a short animation delay and dispatch the weapon action if fire is also held.

units.name: B14_HoldPlayerMotionDelay
units.summary: Load delay ten and return. Shared airborne path uses camera-relative height, input facing, collision and motion tables.

units.name: B14_UpdatePlayerArc
units.summary: Abort motion below the lower screen boundary. Ascending/descending paths use motion-index tables for Y, apply facing-dependent X steps, test terrain and switch state at collision or index limits.

units.name: B14_ClampArcIndex
units.summary: Clamp movement index to $16 at the detected ceiling/contact and return.

units.name: B14_EndArcToState0F
units.summary: Clear motion scratch and enter state $0F.

units.name: B14_BeginDescendingArc
units.summary: Set frame index 1 and delay ten, probe landing/special material/support, then add the vertical motion table and advance index. Early button release can jump index to $14.

units.name: B14_LandPlayerArc
units.summary: Align player Y to eight pixels, enter landing frame two/delay five and request contact audio. The adjacent isolated jump remains separately unknown.

units.name: B14_StepPlayerRightFromTable
units.summary: Add table-selected horizontal delta to 16-bit player X. Movement index is shared with the arc routine.

units.name: B14_StepPlayerLeftFromTable
units.summary: Subtract the same table-selected delta with borrow propagation.

units.name: B14_FinishPlayerHitReaction
units.summary: Start the blink timer. Zero health enters life loss; special mode instead resets a fixed recovery animation.

units.name: B14_UpdatePlayerFallingRecovery
units.summary: While frame zero is active, check camera bounds, terrain, supports and subcell contact, integrate downward motion and optional horizontal drift, and count fall duration. Landing chooses damage or normal recovery; side impact selects the facing-specific reaction.

units.name: B14_DriftPlayerDuringRecovery
units.summary: Interpret current state and movement facing to choose a one-pixel horizontal step, then probe the corresponding side. Obstruction selects the shared reaction state.

units.name: B14_LandPlayerRecovery
units.summary: Align Y and compare fall duration. Long falls or special mode select impact delay and one damage; short falls use the ordinary frame/state transition.

units.name: B14_TickPlayerSustainedFire
units.summary: Update facing from directional input and pace resource consumption while fire is held. Release or exhaustion returns idle; sustained input checks the player attack box.

units.name: B14_SelectPlayerAttackPose
units.summary: Probe support, then quantize relative horizontal contact and facing into the fixed pose table. Retain the alternate attack family when already active; use default state 11 or 20 outside the contact window.

units.name: B14_TickPlayerSpecialMovement
units.summary: Poll fire and four directions. Probe material/support before moving into aligned states; changed direction restarts the animation delay. No input stops movement.

units.name: B14_DispatchSpecialMovementFire
units.summary: Check action/weapon cooldowns and selected stock. Selector six allocates an effect and enters state 1C; other selectors use their stock gates and shared directed/simple effect paths.

units.name: B14_AllocateEffectSlot
units.summary: Search effect types 15 down to zero for a negative free marker. Carry clear returns its index in Y; carry set means the pool is full.

units.name: B14_InitializePool074EEffect
units.summary: Set type two/state zero/lifetime one, reset the shared motion phase, impose the weapon cooldown and consume one unit of pool 074E.

units.name: B14_TickPlayerReactionLeft
units.summary: At selected animation frames, finish the hit reaction or play impact audio. Otherwise require support/ground and clear side probes to preserve movement; failure clears movement facing or selects the shared recovery state.

units.name: B14_TickPlayerReactionRight
units.summary: Mirrored reaction logic with the alternate facing/state helper. Ground, support and side probes can stop drift before animation recovery.

units.name: B14_HandleStandingFire
units.summary: Fire bit gates the action. Horizontal input changes facing and probes terrain; weapon selector/cooldown then chooses the selected firing consumer. Some consumers deliberately discard caller frames.

units.name: B14_FireFacingLeft
units.summary: Set facing four and probe twelve pixels left. Rejection clears movement; an accepted support probe enters the supported weapon state.

units.name: B14_FireFacingRight
units.summary: Set facing two and probe twelve pixels right with the corresponding support-state transition and shared rejection path.

units.name: B14_UnwindWeaponCaller
units.summary: Remove one return address and return directly to the caller's caller.

units.name: B14_EnterSupportWeaponState
units.summary: Require support contact, advance player state by four, reset frame/delay and select movement speed two.

units.name: B14_EnterPlayerWeaponStateTwo
units.summary: Select aimed state two and delay twelve, then spawn through the common directed-effect entry.

units.name: B14_EnterPlayerWeaponStateThree
units.summary: Select aimed state three and delay twelve, then spawn through the common directed-effect entry.

units.name: B14_DispatchWeaponSeven
units.summary: Selector 7 invokes its specialized consumer; selector 2 shares the projectile path and other values enter the alternate firing path.

units.name: B14_EnterProjectileFire
units.summary: Tail-jump to projectile weapon handling.

units.name: B14_AdjustPlayerSupportY
units.summary: A support direction flag and low Y alignment determine a one-pixel upward nudge. Return directly after the adjustment; retain the helper's eight-bit decrement behavior.

units.name: B14_InitializeDirectedEffect
units.summary: Set effect type/state zero and lifetime three. Caller supplies direction and world position.

units.name: B14_SpawnPlayerDirectedEffect
units.summary: Allocate a slot, choose direction from player state/facing and fixed offset tables, initialize world coordinates and request audio. Remove the immediate caller return address on all exits, including exhaustion.

units.name: B14_HandleWalkingFire
units.summary: Probe left/right according to input and dispatch the aimed weapon state. Neutral horizontal input intentionally discards the caller return address before entering idle.

units.name: B14_WalkingFireRight
units.summary: Probe twelve pixels right; acceptance selects facing two and dispatches the aimed weapon, while rejection exits through the common nonlocal return.

units.name: B14_DispatchAimedWeapon
units.summary: Require action cooldown zero. Selected stock and up/down bits choose the aimed state and common effect path; alternate weapons enter their state or simple-effect path. Several returns deliberately skip the calling input handler.

units.name: B14_EnterResourceFire
units.summary: Require a clear cooldown and available $074E resource before invoking the firing consumer.

units.name: B14_SpawnPlayerOverheadEffect
units.summary: Initialize player state 12, allocate a pool-074E effect at facing-dependent X and Y minus 14, and tail-request sound after discarding a caller return address.

units.name: B14_SetCooldownAndAbortCaller
units.summary: Set the weapon cooldown to 50, then join the shared return-address removal. This static entry has a coherent nonlocal contract; its natural caller is unresolved.

units.name: B14_UnwindResourceFireCaller
units.summary: Discard caller return address and return one level further out.

units.name: B14_EnterProjectileWeapon
units.summary: Require cooldown zero and resource at $074C; start a fifteen-tick cooldown and call projectile creation. Empty resource uses the longer cooldown path.

units.name: B14_SpawnAimedSimpleEffect
units.summary: Initialize and position the simple effect above the player, consume pool 074C and request sound. Choose the post-fire player state from the previous aiming family.

units.name: B14_UnwindProjectileCaller
units.summary: Discard one caller frame before returning.

units.name: B14_EmptyWeaponCooldown
units.summary: Load a fifty-tick cooldown and use the shared nonlocal return.

units.name: B14_ConsumeSustainedWeapon
units.summary: If firing latch is clear and ammo exists, raise the weapon meter until $18, then latch sustained fire. Ammo decrements on early ticks; carry reports consumption success.

units.name: B14_HasPool074DStock
units.summary: Return carry set if resource pool 074D is nonzero. Empty stock takes the shared rejection path.

units.name: B14_SustainedWeaponCooldown
units.summary: Load cooldown forty and return carry clear.

units.name: B14_TickTransientEffects
units.summary: Scan sixteen effect slots and dispatch nonnegative type 0..3. Per-effect timers gate motion/state changes; each handler rejoins the common scan, preserving its slot through shared world probes and damage calls.

units.name: B14_AdvanceEffectDirectionCycle
units.summary: Cycle the four direction phases and mark the effect free when the phase wraps. Return through the shared effect-loop continuation.

units.name: B14_AdvanceEffectState
units.summary: When the effect timer reaches zero, advance its state/direction phase. A completed phase cycle frees the effect before the shared scan continuation.

units.name: B14_ReloadEffectTimer
units.summary: Reload timer one on expiry and run the directed-effect movement/contact logic; a live timer returns through the shared scan loop.

units.name: B14_TickDirectedEffect
units.summary: Test level-record and actor contacts, cull offscreen effects and probe terrain. Free motion integrates signed direction tables; contact snaps to the record and enters impact state two with a reset animation.

units.name: B14_SnapDirectedEffectToRecord
units.summary: Use direction-dependent bias to align effect X to the contacted level record, then switch to its impact state.

units.name: B14_SkipEffectTypeOne
units.summary: Return to the next effect slot.

units.name: B14_TickHorizontalEffectEntry
units.summary: Reload timer one when elapsed, then check record/actor/terrain contact and apply horizontal movement.

units.name: B14_TickHorizontalEffect
units.summary: Check actor/record/terrain contact, then integrate the horizontal signed step. Level contact changes the record state and frees the effect; other impacts free it, cancel reserved attachment state and request audio.

units.name: B14_EnterEffectCollisionTail
units.summary: Join the common effect scan continuation after updating the impact animation state.

units.name: B14_TickBouncingEffectEntry
units.summary: Derive displayed effect state from firing cooldown bits, gate movement on its timer and then integrate the bounded bounce curve.

units.name: B14_TickBouncingEffect
units.summary: On each lifetime tick advance a bounded motion phase, integrate mirrored X and table-driven Y, and probe terrain/records. Contacts reverse direction or reset the phase and request bounce audio.

units.name: B14_ProbeBouncingEffectTerrain
units.summary: Probe terrain beneath the effect before checking record and side contacts; the result chooses phase reset, direction reversal or continued motion.

units.name: B14_RetireEffectAfterImpact
units.summary: Mark the selected effect free, cancel/update its reserved actor representation and request impact audio.

units.name: B14_TickVerticalEffectEntry
units.summary: Use cooldown-derived display state and timer-gated vertical curve integration. Terrain contact resets the curve phase and requests bounce audio.

units.name: B14_TickVerticalEffectCurve
units.summary: Advance a bounded phase and integrate the signed Y curve. Terrain contact restarts the phase and plays bounce audio; return through the common effect loop.

units.name: B14_CullOffscreenEffect
units.summary: Subtract the camera coordinates. Free effects outside the current 256-pixel horizontal page or above/below the visible vertical window.

units.name: B14_FindEffectLevelRecordContact
units.summary: Scan active low-nibble level records. Require an accepted coordinate probe and the narrow X window 38 through 4F; carry set returns the record index.

units.name: B14_TestEffectRecordCoordinates
units.summary: Compare effect and level-record world coordinates, reject different high pages and require vertical difference within four times the low state nibble. Carry clear reports acceptance.

units.name: B14_MarkActorStateInactive
units.summary: For nonzero actor state replace flags by $08, then ensure active bit 0 is set. Y selects actor.

units.name: B14_CommitCollectedActorCount
units.summary: Decrement the remaining count and increment the collected count, then return.

units.name: B14_SetActorActiveBit
units.summary: Set actor flag bit 0 without changing its other flags.

units.name: B15_Reset
units.summary: Disable interrupts/decimal mode and rendering, set stack, wait two vblank cycles and clear RAM. Configure mirroring and default options, then call banked screen initialization and initialize inventory. Only established entry contracts identify the switched banks.

units.name: B15_BeginNewGame
units.summary: Reset the stage index and copy configured initial lives into the run counter, then enter the stage setup with a fresh stack.

units.name: B15_RestartStage
units.summary: Reset stack and transient objects, show the mission screen with screen banks 10/11, establish gameplay bank 13, initialize inventory/stage records, upload map/HUD/palette and enable the gameplay NMI before fading in.

units.name: B15_RestoreGameplayTableBank
units.summary: Write MMC3 register seven with physical bank 13, then initialize demo stream, inventory and gameplay runtime. Slot 8000 mapping is established separately by stage setup.

units.name: B15_RunGameplayWork
units.summary: Run actor updates, effects and environmental motion, then distribute secondary work over eight phases. Pause/exit, HUD/collision, palette, culling and inventory run in different phases. Demo timeout or transition flags terminate the foreground loop.

units.name: B15_GameplayPhasePalette
units.summary: Run stage-conditioned palette work before testing foreground completion.

units.name: B15_GameplayPhaseSecondaryCull
units.summary: Update visibility of secondary records.

units.name: B15_GameplayPhaseActors
units.summary: Update visibility and active-slot allocation for actors.

units.name: B15_GameplayPhaseSupport
units.summary: Run player support/material logic.

units.name: B15_GameplayPhasePauseExit
units.summary: Process pause and stage-exit rectangle.

units.name: B15_GameplayPhaseHUDContacts
units.summary: Refresh meters and player/secondary contact processing.

units.name: B15_GameplayPhaseInventory
units.summary: Run inventory/resource/effect updates.

units.name: B15_TestGameplayCompletion
units.summary: Check the gameplay work signal, demo input interruption and demo countdown to choose continued updates or a transition. The ordinary completion tail tests the stage exit window separately.

units.name: B15_EnterStageIntermission
units.summary: Disable gameplay presentation, map the screen pair and choose the failure or continuation screen from remaining counters. Reestablish both gameplay slots before resetting player/camera state.

units.name: B15_ResetPlayerForContinuation
units.summary: Clear camera/scroll/transfer state, place the player at the initial continuation position and initialize facing. Rebuild HUD/map and retire ordinary actors while retaining the special type-six family.

units.name: B15_RunTypeSixContinuation
units.summary: Find remaining type-six actors, choose a target below the player's Y thresholds and move the player/camera into its window. Alternate vertical approach paths until no matching actor remains, then enter the life-loss transition.

units.name: B15_LoseLifeOrReturnTitle
units.summary: Decrement run lives. Nonzero restarts the stage; zero maps the screen pair, runs loss and final-score screens, and returns to inventory/title initialization.

units.name: B15_EnterOrdinaryCompletion
units.summary: Fade out, wait for NMI completion, disable display/audio and map screen banks 10/11 before calling bonus mode eight. Its return increments the stage and selects restart or ending/final-score flows. The saved route reaches this artificially, without proving natural guardian defeat.

units.name: B15_ContinueAfterCompletionBonus
units.summary: Increment the stage. Stages below twelve restart setup; stage twelve runs ending mode four then final-score mode six before returning to the title/inventory path.

units.name: B15_FinishSelectedTypeSixActor
units.summary: Wait for camera motion to settle, pause briefly, enter the selected actor's terminal state and tick its animation/movement until its active slot clears.

units.name: B15_FindRemainingTypeSixActor
units.summary: Search actor indices 31 down to one for type six without the retired flag. Carry set returns the actor in Y; clear means none remain.

units.name: B15_FindTypeSixBelowPlayerOffset
units.summary: Add unsigned A to player Y and search remaining type-six actors at or above that threshold. Carry set returns the selected actor; clear rejects.

units.name: B15_BringSelectedActorIntoView
units.summary: Remember selected actor Y, test horizontal/vertical visibility, and move the player/camera toward it. Choose a vertical approach when the actor is outside the required window.

units.name: B15_IsSelectedActorVerticallyVisible
units.summary: Subtract camera Y from selected actor Y. Carry set reports a zero high byte and low Y below 90; clear rejects.

units.name: B15_IsSelectedActorHorizontallyCentered
units.summary: Subtract camera X from selected actor X. Carry set reports X in 40 through BF on the current page.

units.name: B15_ApproachActorFromAbove
units.summary: If needed center the player and request a camera-axis change, then step Y downward by three over a bounded span, pacing each step by the frame timer and gameplay update helper.

units.name: B15_ApproachActorFromBelow
units.summary: After camera motion stops, step player Y upward by three over a bounded span and tick presentation between steps. Clear the alternate-approach latch on completion.

units.name: B15_AdvancePastActorWindow
units.summary: Center/change camera axis if needed, then move player down by three over a latch-dependent 144- or 240-pixel span, updating gameplay between steps.

units.name: B15_TickContinuationPresentation
units.summary: Prepare pending actor work and invoke the bank-13 gameplay update. Called after frame waits in the scripted continuation movement loops.

units.name: B15_CenterPlayerInWorldPage
units.summary: Move player X by three per frame toward the central 178..181 window in the selected world page. Wait for camera motion and tick presentation throughout; direction depends on the initial page and coordinate.

units.name: B15_AlignPlayerXToSelectedActor
units.summary: Compute the signed 16-bit X difference to the selected actor and step by three toward it. Stop when the difference crosses zero or the actor enters the centered screen window; rescan active type-six targets between steps.

units.name: B15_RefreshSelectedTypeSixActor
units.summary: Search active slots for type-six actors. If the selected target changes, remove the immediate return address and restart the X-alignment routine with the replacement index.

units.name: B15_AlignPlayerYToSelectedActor
units.summary: After camera motion settles, compute the signed 16-bit Y difference and step by three toward the selected actor, ticking frame/presentation work between steps. Stop on crossing the target. Static parameterized contract; natural entry is unresolved.

units.name: B15_ClearTransientStageObjects
units.summary: Clear actor frame pointers, pending-frame flags, level/secondary records and effect types; preserve player slot zero while clearing active slots seven through one.

units.name: B15_WaitForAudioSilence
units.summary: Request command $12 and wait until the audio scheduler marks it consumed.

units.name: B15_DisableGameplayDisplay
units.summary: Disable interrupts/rendering, perform PPU-latch settling writes, disable DMC/frame IRQ and MMC3 IRQ. No checksum/ROM writes occur.

units.name: B15_DefeatGuardianAndAward
units.summary: Zero the selected actor health, enter its defeat state with reset animation, request sound and add 50 score units.

units.name: B15_DefeatActorAndAward
units.summary: Zero selected health, enter defeat state one with reset animation, request sound and add 50 score units.

units.name: B15_EnterActorHitStateAndAward
units.summary: Enter actor state three/frame zero/delay eight, request hit audio and add 30 score units.

units.name: B15_RetireDefeatedActorAtFrameFour
units.summary: At frame four set the retired flag, clear the slot and move actor X high outside the active window.

units.name: B15_CheckPlayerSupport
units.summary: Mode-dependent support handling: ordinary mode requires player state $0D/frame 2; accepted support can enter another player state. Exact surrounding state semantics remain tentative.

units.name: B15_PlayerSupportReturn
units.summary: Return without a support transition.

units.name: B15_CheckAirborneSupport
units.summary: Only a late frame of state $0D tests for support.

units.name: B15_ProbePlayerOriginMaterial
units.summary: Probe actor zero with zero horizontal offset using the material-mask consumer.

units.name: B15_ToggleSpecialMovementMode
units.summary: Toggle the single-bit movement/render mode after the preceding support transition.

units.name: B15_SelectDemoInputStream
units.summary: Use the previous rotating demo index modulo four to load one of four recorded input-stream pointers.

units.name: B15_ReadGameplayController
units.summary: Latch and shift eight controller bits. In demo mode real input sets an interruption flag while a duration/button stream replaces the effective controls; remap banks back to gameplay before returning.

units.name: B15_AdvanceDemoInput
units.summary: Held real input marks interruption. Decrement stream duration and fetch another button/duration pair at expiry.

units.name: B15_ReadDemoInputPair
units.summary: Map screen pair to access demo stream, read two bytes and advance its 16-bit pointer, then restore the level bank and bank 13.

units.name: B15_RasterDelay
units.summary: Fixed NOP run and RTS used for raster timing. Preserve instruction count and call overhead.

units.name: B15_BlankRasterIRQ
units.summary: Preserve A, execute calibrated delay, blank rendering and disable MMC3 IRQ, then return from interrupt.

units.name: B15_GameplayRasterIRQ
units.summary: Preserve registers, delay to raster boundary, select HUD CHR banks and configure scroll/rendering. Arm the next split handler, sample input, tick game timers unless paused, and restore mapper/registers.

units.name: B15_RestoreRasterBank
units.summary: Restore the tracked current PRG bank and decrement the short foreground wait timer if nonzero.

units.name: B15_PrepareScrollTransfer
units.summary: Advance a three-phase transfer state machine. Build row/column tile data into RAM and defer attribute updates/PPU work through the pending flag; on completion release queued camera-direction work.

units.name: B15_BuildScrollTransfer
units.summary: Convert the chosen map strip to staged tiles and set the PPU transfer pointer to RAM $0500.

units.name: B15_RunPendingActorUpdates
units.summary: Wait for NMI work count, process player slot zero until caught up, then update other active slots and inactive-actor dispatch.

units.name: B15_InitializeStageInventory
units.summary: Select the default weapon set. Top up four stock pools below their thresholds, reset health/timers/blink state and clear the remaining auxiliary stock.

units.name: B15_InitializeStageRuntime
units.summary: Clear gameplay scratch/slots and counters, select stage resource/map banks, copy the stage descriptor into pointer/work fields and load difficulty-dependent time. Decode counts and all actor coordinate/type/facing/state planes, initialize health and mark only the player active before the first update.

units.name: B15_LoadDifficultyTimeAndCount
units.summary: Difficulty selects one of the four-byte timer records. Convert the stage count to tens/units, then load PPU control, level flags and all actor record planes from the established stage pointers.

units.name: B15_UploadInitialMapView
units.summary: Initialize strip staging and upload eight coarse map columns, each through two transfer passes. Build both attribute halves and clear pending transfer flags at completion; requires display-safe PPU access.

units.name: B15_BuildMapStrip
units.summary: For eight map records, read map IDs from the map bank and resource/material data from the level bank. Expand each record's 16-byte tile block into RAM staging order according to transfer direction.

units.name: B15_ExpandMapBlock
units.summary: Compute resource pointer as base plus tile ID times 16; copy sixteen bytes using one of two permutation tables. This defines the consumer stride without proving all bank resource extents.

units.name: B15_WorldToMapPointer
units.summary: Input probe X/Y are 16-bit pixels. X groups into 32-pixel cells; Y is divided into fifteen-row pages. Derive within-cell Y bits, combine map base/page offsets and select the map PRG bank. Outputs MapCellPointer and ProbeSubcellY; no data read occurs here.

units.name: B15_GameplayNMI
units.summary: Save A/X/Y, DMA OAM and upload palette. Transfer pending scrolling/HUD data, set CHR selectors and scroll, arm raster split, then build OAM using level and actor renderers. Tick audio, camera and level palette before restoring registers.

units.name: B15_InstallGameplayCHR
units.summary: Select six CHR registers from level/player/actor state, restore PPU control and display, and install the raster IRQ pointer.

units.name: B15_PublishFramePointers
units.summary: Copy pending actor frame pointers only when both-byte publication is ready; copy HUD OAM prefix, then set the sprite output cursors after ten HUD sprites.

units.name: B15_TickAudio
units.summary: Map audio banks 8/9, consume queued command, and tick each of four channels. Caller restores its desired bank context afterward.

units.name: B15_DispatchAudioRequest
units.summary: A negative request is idle. Compare command priority, initialize each nonnegative channel selector through the five fixed 51-byte columns, and mark the request consumed. Audio bank stream packing remains separate from this finite command domain.

units.name: B15_QueueAudioCommand
units.summary: Y is requested command. Option bits suppress music/effects by range; priority can reject a replacement. Keep the accepted command for the NMI audio scheduler.

units.name: B15_TransferScrollOrHUD
units.summary: Pending tile transfer takes precedence over HUD work. Phase 2 updates attributes; other phases stream row/column tiles from RAM with PPU increment direction selected by strip orientation.

units.name: B15_TransferTileStrip
units.summary: Vertical-strip mode writes two staged runs with increment 32, horizontal mode writes a contiguous 64-byte run. Advance pointers and decrement pending transfer count.

units.name: B15_TransferHorizontalStrip
units.summary: Write 64 sequential PPU bytes and advance source/destination by $40.

units.name: B15_ApplyCameraStep
units.summary: Direction 0 does nothing; directions 1..4 adjust camera world coordinates, PPU scroll and map origin. Crossing sixteen-pixel boundaries queues a new strip; thirty-two-pixel crossings advance coarse map coordinates.

units.name: B15_ScrollCameraRight
units.summary: Add speed to camera X and PPU X. Toggle nametable on wrap, and update coarse origin or request a column when boundary bits change.

units.name: B15_ScrollCameraUp
units.summary: Subtract speed from camera Y and vertical scroll with the PPU's 240-line wrap correction; update coarse origin by one map row.

units.name: B15_ScrollCameraDown
units.summary: Add speed to camera Y with 240-line correction. Row and strip boundary crossings schedule map updates.

units.name: B15_QueueDownStrip
units.summary: Use the vertical boundary bit to queue a strip and mark transfer preparation pending.

units.name: B15_ScrollCameraLeft
units.summary: Subtract speed from camera X and PPU X, toggle nametable on borrow and update coarse map origin or prepare a new column.

units.name: B15_PrepareLeftColumn
units.summary: Map origin minus one selects the new column. Derive PPU column address and attribute staging pointer; choose nametable from column range.

units.name: B15_PrepareColumnPPUAndAttributes
units.summary: Mask the coarse column to six bits. Select PPU nametable 2000 or 2400 at column 32, then derive the corresponding 0600/0640 attribute staging address and nametable flag.

units.name: B15_PrepareRightMapStrip
units.summary: Build a strip pointer eight coarse cells beyond the origin, select strip direction two and join the common tile staging address calculation.

units.name: B15_PrepareRightColumn
units.summary: Map origin plus nine selects the new right column; share address/attribute setup with left column preparation.

units.name: B15_PrepareLeftMapStrip
units.summary: Build a strip pointer 64 coarse cells before the origin, select direction one and adjust the PPU destination before common staging.

units.name: B15_PrepareRowAddress
units.summary: Use the wrapped row index to select PPU destination and RAM attribute staging range, then mark the nametable selector.

units.name: B15_PrepareLowerRow
units.summary: Map origin plus $01C0 selects the next lower strip; derive wrapped PPU row with a seven-row bias.

units.name: B15_PrepareLowerBoundaryRow
units.summary: Use a six-row bias for the lower boundary case, sharing the row-address consumer.

units.name: B15_FinishTileQueueOrContinue
units.summary: If the staged count reaches five, discard one caller return address and enter the queue completion path; otherwise return normally.

units.name: B15_RefreshHUDQuarter
units.summary: Without pending map transfer, clear frame work flag and rotate one of four HUD updates: six digits, timer/lives, three resource digits or two-by-two weapon icon. Tile conversion adds $42 to numeric digits.

units.name: B15_UploadHUDSixDigits
units.summary: Write six digit tiles at PPU $232F.

units.name: B15_UploadHUDTimer
units.summary: Write either four timer digits with separator or alternate icon/value fields at $236F.

units.name: B15_UploadHUDResourceDigits
units.summary: Write the three decimal resource digits at $2347.

units.name: B15_UploadHUDWeaponIcon
units.summary: Selected weapon indexes a four-byte tile record; write a two-by-two icon at $2344/$2364.

units.name: B15_UploadNametableAttributes
units.summary: Select RAM attribute source and nametable from X. Copy $30 bytes to $23C0 or $40 bytes to $27C0.

units.name: B15_QueueScrollPreparation
units.summary: Set pending-preparation flag and reset transfer phase; foreground prepares bytes before NMI consumes them.

units.name: B15_GetHorizontalCoarseScroll
units.summary: Combine nametable bit and PPU X, then convert to the strip's aligned horizontal index. Carry input is deliberately supplied by ROR.

units.name: B15_GetVerticalCoarseScroll
units.summary: Convert PPU Y into a 32-pixel row index.

units.name: B15_InitializeHUDSprites
units.summary: Copy the fixed 40-byte OAM template into the HUD shadow in reverse order.

units.name: B15_TestCoarsePlayerProximity
units.summary: A packs X/Y bounds into low/high nibbles. Quantize actor and player world positions to 32-pixel units, compare absolute differences and return carry set inside both bounds. Zero X bound disables that axis test.

units.name: B15_GetActorPlayerDelta
units.summary: Calculate camera-independent actor/player position differences and classify whether the player lies ahead of actor facing. Return carry set for high-byte separation outside the supported one-page range.

units.name: B15_DispatchPlayerAttackDamage
units.summary: Dispatch actor type through supported attack responses. Some types ignore hits; ordinary health-bearing types subtract one with saturation and enter defeat on zero. Carry set means an accepted hit, clear rejection.

units.name: B15_BuildActorCollisionBox
units.summary: Resolve pending frame pointer through active-slot mapping. Frame bytes 9/10 define horizontal half-width and height; subtract width/origin from actor world coordinates to build a rectangle in scratch.

units.name: B15_FindEffectActorOverlap
units.summary: Map frame bank 12 and scan active slots to build rectangles. Compare effect position with caller-supplied bounds, restore level mapping on every return and report overlap in carry. Preserve the selected active slot for damage dispatch.

units.name: B15_SaveCollisionRectangle
units.summary: Copy the first rectangle's coordinates and extents to the saved scratch set before computing the second rectangle.

units.name: B15_TestEffectActorDamage
units.summary: Find overlap then call the type-specific effect damage dispatcher. Carry set reports a hit accepted by both geometry and target state.

units.name: B15_TestAlternateEffectActorDamage
units.summary: Use the same overlap/damage contract for the alternate effect caller; preserve its distinct entry identity.

units.name: B15_TickActorAlongSupportRoute
units.summary: When animation delay expires and the player is visible, locate the route segment. Use actor facing to choose its axis, compare against the two endpoint words and shorten the delay within eight pixels of an endpoint. Endpoint arrival pauses and turns the route direction.

units.name: B15_CheckRouteUpEndpoints
units.summary: Compare actor Y with both vertical endpoint words, adjust the near-endpoint delay and move upward, or pause and turn down at the exact endpoint.

units.name: B15_CheckRouteRightEndpoints
units.summary: Apply the same endpoint/delay logic to actor X while moving right; exact arrival pauses and turns left.

units.name: B15_CheckRouteLeftEndpoints
units.summary: Apply endpoint/delay logic while moving left; exact arrival pauses and turns right.

units.name: B15_FindMovingSupportRecord
units.summary: Search eight-byte records through pointer $0C by actor ID. A negative first byte is the list sentinel; successful lookup returns Y at the next record byte. Missing-sentinel behavior is unproven.

units.name: B15_MoveSupportDown
units.summary: Move support Y down one pixel and, if the player stands on it, move player Y too.

units.name: B15_MoveSupportUp
units.summary: Move support Y up one pixel and carry the standing player with it.

units.name: B15_MoveSupportRightAndCarryPlayer
units.summary: If the player is standing on this support, move player X right one pixel. Move support X right one pixel regardless, preserving both high-byte carries.

units.name: B15_MoveSupportLeft
units.summary: Move support X left one pixel and optionally carry the standing player.

units.name: B15_UpdateMovingSupport
units.summary: Ignore terminal player state. Mark actor active, move according to facing and reverse at the eight-byte route record endpoints. Vertical and horizontal cases use separate coordinate comparisons.

units.name: B15_MoveSupportRightEntry
units.summary: Enter the shared rightward support move: carry the player when standing on the support, then move the support itself one pixel.

units.name: B15_UpdateSupportLeftLimits
units.summary: Move left, find the route record and compare 16-bit X to lower/upper endpoints, reversing direction when necessary.

units.name: B15_TestSupportUpperXLimit
units.summary: Compare upper route endpoint to support X; outside it switch facing to 4.

units.name: B15_FindPlayerSupport
units.summary: Search active slots for actor type 3. If none exists clear support flag and return carry clear; otherwise delegate standing contact test.

units.name: B15_RememberPlayerSupportDirection
units.summary: On accepted support contact, retain the support actor's direction in the player support-motion field.

units.name: B15_TestPlayerStandingOnSupport
units.summary: Require narrow Y gap and horizontal window, then align player eight pixels above support Y. Carry set reports standing contact; clear means no support.

units.name: B15_FormatHUDDecimal
units.summary: Convert unsigned A to hundreds, tens and units by repeated subtraction. Store three binary digits in HUD scratch; no BCD arithmetic is used.

units.name: B15_ApplyEnvironmentalX
units.summary: When unpaused, signed environmental response adds/subtracts one or two pixels from player X depending on movement/facing state. Coordinate arithmetic is 16-bit.

units.name: B15_DispatchEffectDamage
units.summary: Dispatch actor type through effect-specific hit responses. Excluded types clear carry; accepted types use fixed reactions or subtract damage indexed by effect type. Keep actor and active-slot indices distinct.

units.name: B15_EnterActorTerminalHitState
units.summary: Ignore actors already in state three; otherwise reset animation, enter that state and award 30 score units. Carry set reports acceptance.

units.name: B15_ApplyActorSharedHitReaction
units.summary: Reject terminal state three; otherwise invoke the shared hit-state/score helper and return carry set.

units.name: B15_ApplyEffectHealthDamage
units.summary: Reject state one. Subtract damage from the effect-type table; negative health invokes defeat. Surviving targets may stop movement when facing the player. Carry set reports an accepted hit.

units.name: B15_ApplyEffectTransformDamage
units.summary: Subtract effect-type damage from eligible actor health. On negative result, reset slot animation, transform to actor type two/state five with health five and request sound.

units.name: B15_TestTileCollisionMask
units.summary: Read tile ID from map bank, look up material in resource bank, map to a fixed collision mask and test the appropriate subcell bit. Carry set means occupied.

units.name: B15_SubtractPlayerHealth
units.summary: Subtract unsigned damage A and clamp negative results to zero. Return the remaining player health in A and RAM.

units.name: B15_AudioForScreenNMI
units.summary: Tick audio, restore screen PRG pair 10/11 and return.

units.name: B15_ChooseCameraMotion
units.summary: Project player into screen coordinates, clamp vertical overflow, process queued strip work and choose camera direction/speed from dead zones and coarse-axis state. Direction changes wait for transfers to finish.

units.name: B15_CameraSlowLeft
units.summary: Request leftward scroll speed 1; adjacent entry points select speeds 2 and 3.

units.name: B15_HoldCameraAxis
units.summary: Set axis-hold flag while waiting for a stable boundary.

units.name: B15_StopCameraStep
units.summary: Clear direction and speed.

units.name: B15_SettleCameraToBoundary
units.summary: When axis hold is active, choose slow/fast correction toward an aligned PPU scroll boundary; clear queued flags and toggle preferred axis once aligned.

units.name: B15_RequestCameraLeft
units.summary: Direction 4 (left) uses common request logic. Same-direction requests adjust speed by one; changed direction queues work and clears active transfer state when safe.

units.name: B15_RequestCameraDirection
units.summary: X is direction, A is desired speed. Preserve direction while converging speed, or stage the direction until pending strip work completes.

units.name: B15_RequestCameraRight
units.summary: Select direction 2 and enter common camera-request logic.

units.name: B15_RequestCameraUp
units.summary: Select direction 1 and enter common camera-request logic.

units.name: B15_RequestCameraDown
units.summary: Select direction 3 and enter common camera-request logic.

units.name: B15_ConstrainCameraDeadZone
units.summary: Use current axis, PPU scroll and player screen position to approach boundary thresholds. Favor facing/speed state and avoid switching axis until the current strip is settled.

units.name: B15_PrepareQueuedCameraStrip
units.summary: When stationary and no prepared request exists, dispatch queued direction to row/column setup. PPU half-cell bits select which boundary helper is needed.

units.name: B15_PrepareQueuedUpperRow
units.summary: Invoke upper-row strip preparation and join the common transfer staging; caller owns the queued PPU/address state.

units.name: B15_PrepareQueuedRightColumn
units.summary: Use PPU X bit four to choose the appropriate right-column boundary setup, then join the common strip transfer logic.

units.name: B15_PrepareQueuedLowerRow
units.summary: Build the next lower-row transfer.

units.name: B15_PrepareQueuedLowerBoundary
units.summary: Choose lower row based on PPU Y bit 4, then queue preparation; other direction IDs dispatch to the respective column/row helpers.

units.name: B15_InitializeInventory
units.summary: Clear six score digits, initialize stock pools 074B/074D to 99/80 and clear pools 074E/074C. Adjacent helpers test remaining counts and clear flagged level records.

units.name: B15_ClearFlaggedLevelRecords
units.summary: Convert records with bit $80 into state $40 after the transition condition; scan sixteen entries.

units.name: B15_AdvanceFlaggedRecord
units.summary: Continue backwards through the sixteen level records.

units.name: B15_CheckGuardianProgress
units.summary: Use the stage route entry to select the exit condition. With a route, require both guardian X high bytes at least 0F before clearing flagged level records; without a route, use the remaining-count test. This explains the gate mechanically without claiming natural guardian defeat.

units.name: B15_RunAttractDemo
units.summary: Clear objects/presentation, enable demo mode and initialize its stream counters, then enter gameplay setup. After the fixed continuation returns, remap screen banks, clear demo mode and reset inventory before returning.

units.name: B15_BeginTransitionFade
units.summary: Request fade out, wait for NMI completion and reset display. Then map the screen pair, clear demo mode and invoke the screen transition fade before returning.

units.name: B15_HasActivePool074EEffect
units.summary: Scan all effect slots for type two or three. Carry set reports an existing effect; clear permits a new allocation.

units.name: B15_CopyEffectToReservedActor
units.summary: Copy the selected effect's four position planes into reserved actor 1C. Caller initializes its state/flags separately.

units.name: B15_SpawnReservedActorStateZero
units.summary: Cancel any prior reserved active slot, copy effect coordinates and activate actor 1C in state zero.

units.name: B15_SpawnReservedActorStateOne
units.summary: Cancel the previous reserved slot, copy effect coordinates and activate actor 1C in state one.

units.name: B15_IRQVectorTrampoline
units.summary: Jump through RAM IRQPointer; selected handler depends on current screen/raster state.

units.name: B15_NMIVectorTrampoline
units.summary: Jump through RAM NMIPointer; foreground installs gameplay or screen handlers.

units.name: B15_AttractDemoVector
units.summary: Fixed-bank trampoline to the attract demo helper. The preceding uniform data suffix ends exactly at this instruction.

units.name: B15_ScreenAudioTrampoline
units.summary: Fixed-bank trampoline to the audio/screen-bank restoration helper.

units.name: INESHeader
units.summary: Validated 16-byte iNES header: mapper 4, 128 KiB PRG, 128 KiB CHR, no trainer. Header bytes are separate from CPU/PPU storage.

units.name: PauseShortcutStates
units.summary: Ten controller-state bytes consumed by the pause shortcut comparator. Each accepted step requires release before advancing; complete sequence enters the level transition. See scenarios.json for the tested input recipe.

units.name: InterruptVectorWords
units.summary: Three little-endian CPU vectors: NMI $FE82, reset $E000, IRQ $FE7F. These point to fixed-bank trampolines, not physical file offsets.

units.name: CHRPlanarTiles
units.summary: PPU-only CHR ROM: 8192 planar 8x8 tiles, 16 bytes per tile (low plane then high plane). MMC3 CHR selection controls visible tiles; semantic tile grouping is not recovered.

units.name: B00_LevelComponentTemplate
units.summary: Level-column component template: attribute/tile pairs indexed from Y=5 or 7. AppendTemplateSprite increments Y before each byte, so preserve the original cursor bias. Exact component selection follows the packed record type.

units.name: B00_SecondaryComponentOffsets
units.summary: Two four-byte coordinate-bias columns, X then Y, indexed 3 down to 0 by DrawSecondaryQuad. These project the four template components; bytes retain their unsigned addition/carry behavior.

units.name: B00_SecondaryComponentTemplates
units.summary: Secondary draw attribute/tile pairs selected with twice the component index plus the record frame bias. Nearby repeated template content is non-code; the exact original grouping of the whole span remains unresolved.

units.name: B00_EffectFrameRemap
units.summary: Eight effect-frame remap values, consumed before doubling and biasing the component cursor. The table is bounded by the adjoining template data and renderer code.

units.name: B00_EffectComponentTemplates
units.summary: Effect attribute/tile pairs read through the sprite-frame pointer and selected by the effect state/frame paths. The common writer starts immediately after this data at 9E84.

units.name: B00_RendererFlipData
units.summary: Small renderer flip/index constants bracketed by the component writer and occlusion routine. Exact original table grouping is unresolved; no instruction role is inferred.

units.name: B00_OcclusionRowRemap
units.summary: Sixteen quantized row/nametable offsets. The occlusion helper adds a masked vertical cell offset to this horizontal-index result before reading the 0600 visibility grid.

units.name: B00_StageInitializationTail
units.summary: Stage-dependent initialization/record bytes and zero runs. Repeated record patterns and exact renderer boundaries support non-code, but the full schema is unresolved. These tails differ between level banks; only the established renderer instruction slices are identical.

units.name: AudioEnableMaskBits
units.summary: Four channel enable masks indexed by channel X during initialization. These feed the APU enable shadow; channel stride and stream state are separate.

units.name: AudioNoteTimerColumns
units.summary: Split note timer low/high columns at 841F and 8474. Pitched channel initialization and modulation read these by note index; noise uses its note value directly as a period.

units.name: AudioTablesAndStreams
units.summary: Audio table/stream domain after the channel update return. Word track pointers begin 84C9; timing pointers 856D; split 128-entry pattern pointers 8622/86A2; volume pointer columns 8722/8742; pitch 8761/8769; duty 8771/8779; note-offset 8782/87C2; four-byte instruments 8E3C. Track FF redirects and FE stops; pattern FF returns to track selection; envelope/modulation sentinels follow their individual consumers. Command streams mix notes, transpose, duration, instrument, slide and cursor controls. Origins are consumer-anchored; every guessed original stream packing boundary is not established. Remaining bytes are generic encoded non-code, with precise composer schema unresolved.

units.name: ScreenModeDispatchWords
units.summary: Eleven little-endian handler words indexed by finite mode 0..10. Fixed callers select the mission, title, timed, completion, ending and score flows. Words are CPU addresses requiring screen banks 10/11, not physical pointers.

units.name: DemoStageIndices
units.summary: Four zero-based stage choices for the rotating attract demonstration. The title advances its selector modulo four before the next invocation.

units.name: TitleAnimationSelectors
units.summary: Three eight-phase title sprite selectors/masks consumed by the animation tick. Their low phase index controls the three tile-group movements; original visual labels remain unresolved.

units.name: TitleFadeColorIndices
units.summary: Palette-index/brightness selection bytes bounded by the fade worker and screen command handler. Consumer indexing establishes their non-code role; exact original subtable grouping is unresolved.

units.name: MissionSubtitleResources
units.summary: Stage subtitle pointer columns and FF-terminated text strings. FFFF omits an optional subtitle field; the consumer subtracts 20 from text bytes to obtain tile indices.

units.name: MissionAnimationPositions
units.summary: Four OAM destination offsets followed by ten four-byte Y-position phases. The mission animation advances one phase every seven screen ticks.

units.name: ScreenSevenAnimationData
units.summary: Two thirteen-byte replacement tile rows followed by the 128-step signed OAM Y displacement sequence. Animation switches the tile rows at phases 90 and 110; exact picture identity is unresolved.

units.name: EndingTextPayload
units.summary: 975 printable text bytes followed by FF. The scrolling text consumer advances by 32-byte rows and sets EndingTextFinished at the terminal byte; this string is separate from the adjacent IRQ code.

units.name: ScreenResourceColumns
units.summary: Eleven entries per mode: tile-stream words 973F, tile biases 9755, CHR register columns 9760/976B, attribute words 9776, palette words 978C and OAM words 97A2. The consumer independently indexes each column with the same finite mode.

units.name: ScreenResourceData
units.summary: Screen tile/text, palette, attribute, OAM and animation resources. All eleven selected tile streams use little-endian PPU run addresses and FF terminators; FE selects text conversion by minus 20. Attributes copy exactly 64 bytes, palettes 32 bytes, and sprite payloads contain four-byte OAM records with a terminal marker. Consumer-selected streams were parsed independently; surrounding repeated animation/resource bytes remain generic non-code where their exact schema is unresolved. Do not assume the entire span is one serialized table.

units.name: ActorFrameRecords
units.summary: 159 bounded actor frame records, including four unreferenced records matching the consumer format. Each has an eleven-byte header, then four-byte sprite components (X, Y, attributes, tile) and a single FF component terminator. Header offsets 2/3 are origin X/Y, 4 participates in motion, 8 selects CHR, 9/10 give collision half-width/height, and 11 begins components. Renderer forward/mirrored paths and fixed rectangle builders share these records. The 155 referenced records plus four exact gap records cover this whole domain; unreferenced does not mean unused.

units.name: ActorRendererFlipConstants
units.summary: Five local renderer flip/index constants, bracketed by the OAM writer and standalone occlusion helper. Exact original grouping remains unresolved.

units.name: ActorStateAndMotionData
units.summary: Player motion step columns begin A000/A036; other HUD, motion and state resources share this non-code domain. Actor type roots at A599 (frame states), A5B7 (behavior states), A5D5 (inactive initializers) each contain fifteen little-endian words. Matched per-type state counts are 37,4,6,1,1,9,4,2,3,2,2,1,3,4,1. Frame-state entries select 74 sentinel sequences: frame words end at FFFF followed by a replacement-state word within the same type domain. Behavior words select bank-13/fixed routines after C5C6 restores the level bank; do not interpret frame bank 12 as the behavior execution slot. Remaining repeated records are generic data where full field semantics are unresolved.

units.name: HUDMarkerLookupBytes
units.summary: Small lookup bytes adjoining the HUD marker/update worker. Local consumers and non-instruction patterns were checked; precise field/group meaning remains unresolved.

units.name: RelativeActorLookupRows
units.summary: Thirteen row-base values used after folding relative actor coordinates around the lookup center. Add the folded Y index to form the fixed-table lookup index.

units.name: DirectedEffectLaunchOffsets
units.summary: Two signed little-endian launch-offset columns: X at BCBD and Y at BCC5. Facing and player aiming state select the doubled entry index.

units.name: FixedStageAndMotionData
units.summary: Stage descriptor words C019; resource banks C031; map banks C03D; stage route stream words C055/C06D; effect damage values C085. Signed motion columns C08A/C0B4/C0FC and launch/facing tables C146..C1B8 serve player/effect/contact routines. C1C4 contains subcell masks. These are consumer origins, not a claim that every intervening byte has a recovered schema; retain unresolved repeated constants as generic non-code.

units.name: TerrainSubcellMasks
units.summary: Seven sixteen-byte subcell collision masks. The material record supplies a three-bit mask selector; the probe combines masked X/Y subcells, optionally mirrors the column with bit 80, and reports a nonzero mask cell as contact.

units.name: ActorRiseSteps
units.summary: Local bounded rise-step bytes used by the actor curve phase. Eight selected steps precede the neighboring behavior entry; remaining bounded constants retain their exact values.

units.name: PlayerFallStepColumns
units.summary: Two sixteen-byte indexed displacement columns: horizontal at D207 and vertical at D217. The falling arc advances a bounded phase, mirrors X by facing and integrates both coordinate high bytes.

units.name: Pool074ELaunchXWords
units.summary: Two signed little-endian X launch offsets selected from compact facing. The corresponding effect uses player Y plus four.

units.name: SimpleEffectLaunchXWords
units.summary: Two signed little-endian launch X offsets indexed by doubled facing. Used by both standing and aimed simple-effect paths.

units.name: RelativeActorLookupValues
units.summary: Bounded lookup bytes indexed by the folded relative-position worker in bank 13. The consumer establishes coordinate mechanics; exact semantic category of each result remains unresolved.

units.name: FixedOcclusionRowRemap
units.summary: Sixteen quantized row offsets used by the actor occlusion helper to combine horizontal nametable cells with masked vertical rows before reading 0600.

units.name: DemoInputStreamWords
units.summary: Four little-endian pointers selected by the rotating title-demo index. Recorded input streams are consumed by the fixed demo playback code.

units.name: AudioCommandColumns
units.summary: Five adjacent 51-byte columns: command priority and four channel track selectors. The fixed command consumer indexes all columns by one request. Music test requests 4..17, effect test 19..49 and initialization command 50 are valid. Zero/FF and track selectors retain consumer-specific meanings; this is separate from audio-bank stream packing.

units.name: HUDSpriteTemplate
units.summary: Ten four-byte OAM records copied to HUD shadow at initialization. Record order is Y, tile, attributes, X; game-specific glyph names are not recovered.

units.name: SupportEndpointDelays
units.summary: Short delay lookup indexed by distance within eight pixels of route endpoints. Endpoint equality uses a separate 20-tick pause before changing direction.

units.name: StageExitAndCollisionData
units.summary: Twelve little-endian stage exit X words at FE24 and twelve Y words at FE3C. The completion test accepts unsigned offsets less than 32 on both axes. Tile collision masks begin FE54; remaining bounded bytes are local constants with unresolved grouping, separate from the IRQ trampoline.

units.name: FixedZeroSuffix
units.summary: 367 uniform zero bytes after the complete indirect-vector instruction and before the rooted attract-demo trampoline. Generic non-code only: no original linker-fill or allocation-purpose claim. FE84 is part of the preceding instruction and is excluded.
